- Opposition: potential disruption to the alpine environment and sacredness of Mauna Kea to Native Hawaiians; protests, with construction temporarily halted by a blockade after October 2014.
- Funding and partners: Moore Foundation US$200 million; Caltech and University of California US$50 million each; cost estimated $970 million to $1.4 billion in 2009 and expected to top $1 billion shared by India and China (2012); India a full member in 2014; Japan (NAOJ) a collaborator from 2008; by 2024 China was not a partner. Larsen & Toubro contracted in 2019 for the segment support assembly. Government-level support from Canada, Japan and India.

wikis.title: Thirty Meter Telescope environmental compliance (NSF)
wikis.summary: NSF's environmental review status page for a potential federal investment in the Thirty Meter Telescope, noting delayed Section 106 consultations and an extended review end date of Dec. 31, 2026.
wikis.body:
- NSF is considering a potential future investment in construction and operations of the TMT, an Extremely Large Telescope in the Northern Hemisphere; it "will not make a funding decision until after it considers" the environmental review and engagement. NSF acknowledges building on Maunakea, Hawaii Island is "a sensitive issue".
- Status update: NSF delayed National Historic Preservation Act Section 106 consultation meetings to align with other agency-wide activities; consulting parties confirmed interest in 2024; will share when the process may resume.
- Milestone dates in the Notice of Intent are outdated; NSF extended the anticipated end of the environmental review to Dec. 31, 2026.
- Public scoping under NEPA ran July 19-September 17, 2022, with a draft Community Engagement Plan comment period over the same dates.
- An external panel convened July 2024 on financial resources, partnerships and governance for the US Extremely Large Telescope projects (Giant Magellan Telescope and TMT) issued its final report Dec. 9, 2024; it was not part of the environmental review.

wikis.title: The Thirty Meter Telescope is still alive, for now (Civil Beat, March 2026)
wikis.summary: Civil Beat report that Congress's appropriations language keeps TMT under consideration for federal support alongside the Giant Magellan Telescope, with no new funding and a roughly $1 billion shortfall.
wikis.body:
- Congress bought time for TMT on Mauna Kea. The project has a funding shortfall of about $1 billion (of an estimated $3 billion) and appeared dead last year after NSF recommended funding the Giant Magellan Telescope in Chile amid federal budget cuts (GMT expected to cost about $2.5 billion).
- A recent appropriations bill, signed by President Trump, directs NSF to advance both telescopes to final design review, with no additional funding and at no additional cost to the federal government. Rep. Ed Case requested it: "There is no reason to prematurely narrow our options."
- The GMT final design phase is privately funded and expected to finish in two years; whether TMT can finish without federal support is unclear. The bill also directs $30 million for "next generation astronomy facilities" from Astro2020. NSF must brief lawmakers in coming months.
- Partners: Caltech, national science departments of Japan and India, Canada's NRC, University of California, and an association of researchers at 45 institutions. The observatory is exploring the Canary Islands, but the Big Island remains its top site.
- Protests in 2015 and 2019 halted construction; a new Mauna Kea authority takes over management of many lands in 2028 and will decide on new facilities.

wikis.title: Lima and Callao Metro (Line 1 and Line 2) - Wikipedia overview
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the Lima and Callao Metro, covering Line 1 (opened fully 2014) and Line 2, whose first five stations opened December 21, 2023.
wikis.body:
- Lima and Callao Metro is a rapid transit system; lines 1 and 2 link Villa El Salvador with San Juan de Lurigancho and a 5 km eastern segment; four more lines planned.
- Line 1: full operations July 28, 2014 after decades of delays; construction began under Alan Garcia's first presidency (1985-1990); 34.6 km elevated, 26 stations; longest elevated viaduct in Latin America.
- Line 2: west-east, entirely underground, 27 km, fully automated, announced by President Humala on February 15, 2012; linking Callao port, the historic center, Santa Anita and Ate. Consortium "Nuevo Metro de Lima" (COSAPI, Impregilo, Ansaldo, Iridium, Vialia) won the bid; contract signed April 28, 2014. CAF loan US$300 million approved August 18, 2009 (for the project).
- Stage 1A opened December 21, 2023: five stations, 5 km from Evitamiento to Mercado Santa Anita, not yet connected to Line 1. The rest "is currently under construction, and projected to be completed by 2028" (citation needed per the page).

wikis.title: Lima Metro Line 2 full operation starts in 2028, says transport minister (Infobae)
wikis.summary: Infobae report (Nov 11, 2023) that MTC minister Raul Perez Reyes said Line 2 will operate 100% in five years, with the first five stations to open in December 2023.
wikis.body:
- MTC minister Raul Perez Reyes said the first five short sections open in December but 100% operation of the first underground train will start in five years; "If there is no further interference, it finishes in 2028". Unmapped infrastructure keeps appearing (MTC has an expropriations and interferences unit).
- Stage 1A (Mercado Santa Anita, Hermilio Valdizan, Colectora Industrial, Ovalo Santa Anita, Evitamiento) is complete; "marcha blanca" begins December 21 for 90 days to mid-March, with free fares.
- Five stations, six kilometres, about 6 minutes, versus 25-30 minutes by car.
- After that, a social fare from April 2024, not exceeding S/2 per a former minister, versus the concessionaire's initial US$0.7 (about S/2.60). ATU president Jose Aguilar Reategui seeking a fair fare.
- Final project: 27 stations across 10 districts (Ate, Santa Anita, El Agustino, San Luis, La Victoria, Cercado, Brena, Bellavista, Carmen de la Legua, Callao).

wikis.title: The Gordie Howe International Bridge opens (official site)
wikis.summary: Official announcement that the Gordie Howe International Bridge opened to vehicles on July 27, 2026 after nearly eight years of construction.
wikis.body:
- On July 27, 2026 vehicles crossed the new bridge for the first time. Gordie Howe's grandson Gordie and wife Margaret Howe made the first passenger crossing from Canada to the U.S.; Onfreight Logistics of Windsor made the first commercial truck crossing; nearly 8,000 crossings that day.
- Nearly eight years of construction, over 25 years of planning; since 2018, 15,800 people worked over 20.1 million hours.
- A direct highway-to-highway link between Ontario's Highway 401 and Michigan's Interstate-75. Opening day also debuted the programmable aesthetic lights and public art display "Shimmer" by Douglas Coupland.

wikis.title: Gordie Howe International Bridge will open on July 27 (Government of Canada, July 10, 2026)
wikis.summary: Canada.ca release that Canada and Michigan agreed to open the Gordie Howe International Bridge on July 27, with toll governance measures and a 15-year economic development fund.
wikis.body:
- Windsor, July 10, 2026: Canada and Michigan agreed to open the bridge on July 27 with US government support. The Windsor-Detroit corridor is the busiest international land border crossing in North America with hundreds of millions of dollars of daily trade.
- Bridge: six-lane cable-stayed, main span 853 metres (longest of its kind in North America), about 2.5 km long; ports of entry on both sides.
- Cooperative measures: toll governance and transparency, and a 15-year economic development fund tied to a portion of profits from bridge operations. The Windsor-Detroit Bridge Authority will work with the U.S. government on toll-rate adjustments, seeking concurrence for certain non-market related toll changes.
- Quotes from Canada's infrastructure minister Gregor Robertson and Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer.

wikis.title: Court rejects Moroun lawsuit to block Gordie Howe bridge (Detroit News, May 2018)
wikis.summary: Detroit News report that the Michigan Court of Appeals rejected an Ambassador Bridge owner's lawsuit seeking to block construction of the Gordie Howe International Bridge.
wikis.body:
- On a Tuesday, the Michigan Court of Appeals rejected a lawsuit by Ambassador Bridge owner Manuel "Matty" Moroun to block the planned bridge; another appeal is possible. Gov. Rick Snyder praised it and expected to attend a groundbreaking that summer.
- Three-judge panel (Shapiro, Kelly, O'Brien) upheld a Court of Claims ruling that Moroun companies missed a one-year statute of limitations, since notice was due within a year of the 2012 crossing agreement between Michigan and Canada.
- The Detroit International Bridge Co. sued in December 2016 after the state made "good faith offers" for land in the bridge footprint. The Moroun family wants to twin its span, which opened in 1929, but has only won Canadian approval to replace it.
- The bridge is a public-private partnership that will compete for tolls with the Ambassador Bridge.

wikis.title: Grand Egyptian Museum (Wikipedia overview)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's description of the Grand Egyptian Museum in Giza, its history, delays, size, collections and official opening on 1 November 2025.
wikis.body:
- National archaeological museum in Giza, Egypt, about 2 km (1.2 mi) from the Giza Pyramid Complex; described as the largest museum in the world for a single civilization.
- Holds an estimated total of over 100,000 artifacts, Predynastic Period to Roman Egypt, in 12 main permanent exhibition halls plus other halls; includes the second solar ship of Khufu, the collection of Queen Hetepheres and the collection of Yuya and Thuya.
- Site area 500,000 m2; built-up area 167,000 m2; floor area 81,000 m2.
- Architects Roisin Heneghan and Shih-Fu Peng; director Ahmed Ghoneim; built by a joint venture of Orascom Construction and BESIX Group. Cost $1.2 billion.
- Visitors: 19,000 daily (cited figure); Cairo Metro Line 4 Pyramids Station "under construction".

## Timeline
- Concept from the early 1990s (Farouk Hosni, culture minister 1987-2011); officially launched 1992 under President Hosni Mubarak; foundation stone 2002; construction began 2005; fully completed in 2023.
- Opening postponed repeatedly: scheduled 2020, then 2021 (COVID-19), then end of 2022/early 2023, then end of 2023, then May 2024 (minister Ahmed Issa) - did not happen.
- Trial opening to 4,000 visitors in October 2024; final date then set for 3 July 2025, postponed (PM Mostafa Madbouly cited the Twelve-Day War between Iran and Israel).
- On 6 August 2025 Madbouly announced President el-Sisi agreed to 1 November 2025. Museum closed 15 October to 3 November 2025, resumed to visitors 4 November (103rd anniversary of Tutankhamun's tomb discovery).
- Official inauguration 1 November 2025 attended by el-Sisi and foreign royals/leaders (e.g. King Philippe of Belgium, King Felipe VI, Queen Rania, Frank-Walter Steinmeier, Kyriakos Mitsotakis).
- Roughly 1.5 million visitors over 10 months since October 2024 (about 4,000 per day in trial); 18,000 visitors on the first day after official opening.

wikis.title: Egypt's Grand Museum opens, Tutankhamun tomb shown in full
wikis.summary: BBC report of 1 November 2025 on the official opening of the Grand Egyptian Museum near the Giza pyramids.
wikis.body:
- BBC News, 1 November 2025 (Yolande Knell, Wael Hussein). Egypt officially opened the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), "described as the world's largest archaeological museum", near the Great Pyramid of Khufu.
- About 100,000 artefacts covering some seven millennia, from pre-dynastic times to Greek and Roman eras.
- Main draw: the entire contents of Tutankhamun's tomb displayed together for the first time since Howard Carter found it (gold mask, throne, chariots). Dr Tarek Tawfik: about 1,800 of over 5,500 pieces had been on display since 1922.
- Also a new display of Khufu's 4,500-year-old funerary boat; most other galleries open since 2024. Public opening awaited on 4 November.
- Cost about $1.2bn (GBP910m); expected to attract up to 8m visitors a year.
- 500,000 sq m site (about 70 football pitches); alabaster and hieroglyph exterior, pyramid-shaped entrance; a 16m suspended obelisk of Ramesses II and his 11m statue (moved from near Cairo railway station in 2006); grand staircase with statues; window view of the pyramids.
- First proposed in 1992 under Mubarak, construction began 2005; hit by financial crises, the 2011 Arab Spring, Covid-19 and regional wars.
- Zahi Hawass: wants the Rosetta Stone (British Museum), Zodiac (Louvre) and Nefertiti bust (Berlin) returned; Egyptologists say the museum strengthens repatriation demands.

wikis.title: Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam: overview, construction and filling
wikis.summary: Wikipedia (part 1) on the GERD on the Blue Nile: specifications, construction history, filling phases, commissioning and inauguration on 9 September 2025, and early controversy.
wikis.body:
- Gravity, roller-compacted concrete dam on the Blue Nile in Guba, Benishangul-Gumuz Region, near the Sudan border; owner/operator Ethiopian Electric Power. Formerly "Project X", then Millennium Dam; renamed GERD by the Council of Ministers on 15 April 2011.
- Specs: length 1,780 m, height 145 m, crest elevation 655 m, 10.4 million m3; reservoir (Nigat Lake) 74 billion m3 total, 59.2 active, 1,874 km2, up to 246 km long, 140 m deep. Installed capacity 5.15 GW (11 x 400 MW + 2 x 375 MW Francis turbines); planned annual generation 15.76 TWh (est.). Cost more than US$5 billion. Called the largest hydroelectric plant in Africa.
- Site identified by the US Bureau of Reclamation Blue Nile survey 1956-1964. Contract of US$4.8 billion awarded without competitive bidding to Salini Impregilo on 31 March 2011; foundation stone 2 April 2011 (Meles Zenawi). Originally slated for completion July 2017; funded by government bonds and private donations.
- Filling: first July 2020 (540 m); second completed 19 July 2021 (~575 m); third 12 August 2022 (600 m); fourth 10 September 2023 (~625 m); fifth and last October 2024 (640 m).
- First power 20 February 2022 (375 MW); second 375 MW turbine August 2022; third and fourth 400 MW turbines August 2024. Formally inaugurated 9 September 2025.
- Egypt, over 2,500 km downstream and reliant on the Nile for about 90% of its water, opposes the dam; described as a source of severe regional controversy.

wikis.title: Ethiopia inaugurates GERD amid tensions with Egypt and Sudan
wikis.summary: Al Jazeera report of 9 September 2025 on the GERD inauguration and downstream concerns.
wikis.body:
- Published 9 Sep 2025. Ethiopia inaugurated "Africa's largest hydroelectric dam" on the Blue Nile, a $5bn project. PM Abiy Ahmed called it a "shared opportunity"; expected to generate more than 5,000 MW and allow exports of surplus power.
- Attendees included Kenya's William Ruto and Somalia's Hassan Sheikh Mohamud; festivities began the night before with lanterns and drones. Egyptian and Sudanese leaders did not attend.
- Dam is 14 km east of the Sudanese border, 1.8 km wide, 145 m tall. Built by Webuild (CEO Pietro Salini said regulating the water will "create an additional benefit").
- Egypt and Sudan fear for water security and breach of international law; the previous week they issued a joint statement calling Ethiopia's actions "unilateral" and a "continuous threat to stability". Talks have stalled since 2011.
- Sudan's Roseires Dam, about 110 km downstream, could be affected by uncoordinated releases; its manager said GERD has helped control overflow and silt. A Bahir Dar University professor said it could bring regional integration.

wikis.title: Webuild press release: GERD inaugurated
wikis.summary: Webuild's 9 September 2025 press release on the inauguration of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam, which it designed and built.
wikis.body:
- Milan, 9 September 2025: Ethiopia inaugurated the GERD, "the largest hydropower project ever built in Africa", designed and built by Webuild and commissioned by Ethiopian Electric Power. Attended by Webuild CEO Pietro Salini, PM Abiy Ahmed Ali and heads of state of several African countries.
- Installed capacity more than 5,000 MW; expected annual output 15,700 GWh (said to equal three medium-sized nuclear plants); expected to double Ethiopia's electricity production.
- Reservoir 172 km long, up to 74 billion m3.
- Main dam 170 m tall (Webuild's figure), 1,800 m at crest, 10.7 million m3 of concrete; largest roller-compacted concrete gravity dam by volume in Africa. On 28 December 2014 the site set a world record with 23,000 m3 of RCC in 24 hours.
- More than 25,000 people worked on it, mostly Ethiopians; a new town with hospital, two clinics, school, sports facilities and a bakery was built at the site.
- Linked to Italy's Mattei Plan. Webuild has worked in Ethiopia for over 70 years (30 projects incl. Beles, Gibe III at 250 m; Koysha dam under construction). Worldwide: 318 dams and hydro plants, 53,659 MW.

wikis.title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max open for pre-order
wikis.summary: MacRumors, 12 September 2026: Apple opens pre-orders for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, with pricing, colours and delivery date.
wikis.body:
- Saturday 12 September 2026 (Juli Clover): Apple accepting pre-orders for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max via its online store and Apple Store app, in more than 65 countries and regions.
- Features listed: new variable aperture Main camera, faster A20 Pro chip, improved vapor chamber cooling, upgraded 5G modems, longer battery life, faster charging, smaller Dynamic Island. Colours: silver, black, glacier, burgundy.
- Pricing: iPhone 18 Pro from $1,199 (256GB); Pro Max from $1,299; up to 2TB at higher prices.
- Deliveries start Friday, September 18.
- No lower-cost iPhone 18 offered now; "the iPhone Duo won't launch until October 23", so demand for Pro models may be high.
- Carriers (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) and retailers (Best Buy, Walmart) also take pre-orders; Apple Upgrade program offers monthly payments.
- Related coverage mentions the "Surprise and Shine" event on 9 September 2026 and a TrendForce price estimate for iPhone 18 Pro made before the event.

wikis.title: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
wikis.summary: Apple's newsroom announcement of the iPhone 18 Pro models: variable-aperture camera, A20 Pro, vapor chamber, battery, and availability.
wikis.body:
- Announced from Cupertino; pre-orders begin Saturday, September 12 (2026), availability Friday, September 18. Finishes: black, silver, glacier, all-new burgundy. Runs iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.
- Camera: new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture (six laser-cut blades, four aperture settings, widening to f/1.48, portraits at f/1.8, narrowing to f/4); developer API; new sensor and computational imaging pipeline; Photographic Styles texture and grain controls; Cinematic effects after capture at up to 60 fps; 4K Dolby Vision time-lapse; "Pro controls" (aperture, shutter speed, white balance, histogram).
- Apple Reference Image: signed sensor data developed by Private Cloud Compute into an unalterable reference image to prove authenticity; upcoming SynthID standard support.
- Dynamic Island smaller, shows up to three Live Activities; Face ID retained.
- A20 Pro on 2-nanometer process: 6-core CPU with 50% more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro, 7-core GPU up to 40% faster, Dual 16-core Neural Engine. N1 chip (Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, Thread); C2 modem (15% less energy than C1X, mmWave in the U.S.).
- New vapor chamber with three times the surface area of iPhone 17 Pro; up to 40% gain in sustained performance.
- Battery (eSIM-only models): up to 36 hours video playback on iPhone 18 Pro, up to 45 hours on Pro Max.
- Quote from Greg Joswiak, SVP Worldwide Marketing.

wikis.title: Apple announces September 9 'Surprise and shine' event
wikis.summary: 9to5Mac on 26 August 2026: Apple confirms its September 9 event and the rumoured iPhone 18 Pro, foldable iPhone and Apple Watch lineup.
wikis.body:
- Aug 26 2026 (Zac Hall): Apple announced an event for September 9 at 10 am PT, tagline "Surprise and shine"; streamed on apple.com, YouTube and the Apple TV app, expected prerecorded.
- Expected: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max (same general designs; variable-aperture camera, smaller Dynamic Island, Apple C2 modem; rumoured colours dark cherry, black, silver, light blue); Apple's first foldable iPhone, rumoured to be called "iPhone Ultra" (book-style, 5.3-5.5 inch outer and 7.6-7.8 inch inner display, titanium frame, possibly Touch ID in power button; starting price estimates around $1,999, some reports up to $2,500).
- No standard iPhone expected this fall; iPhone 18, 18e and Air 2 reportedly follow in spring 2027.
- Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 expected with new processors and health upgrades, no major redesign; AirPods 5 expected. New Mac mini and Mac Studio set for release September 22.
- John Ternus to take over as Apple CEO on September 1, with Tim Cook becoming executive chairman.

wikis.title: Apple Watch Series 12 announced with S11 chip and new health sensors
wikis.summary: MacRumors, 9 September 2026: Apple Watch Series 12 with S11 chip, redesigned health sensing, ceramic finishes, price and availability.
wikis.body:
- Wednesday 9 September 2026 (Tim Hardwick): Apple announced Apple Watch Series 12 with S11 chip and redesigned health sensing system.
- Finishes: aluminum Space Gray, Black, Light Gold, Dark Bronze (now with Ceramic Shield, screens 60% tougher); polished titanium Radiant Gold and Natural; ceramic Pearl White and Night Blue.
- Sensors: larger ECG electrode surface, photodiodes in a ring, larger green LEDs; Apple cites a study with hundreds of participants against an ECG chest strap. New Readiness score (recover / pace / more activity).
- Health app redesign with Apple Intelligence: Health Age (VO2 max, sleep, blood biomarkers) and Longevity tab; in the U.S. a Quest blood panel of 50+ biomarkers for $119; a VO2 max test using iPhone camera. Redesigned Health app "later this year".
- S11 Audio Intelligence: Sound Recognition, Live Rewind (transcript of preceding 15 seconds), Siri Recap (beta later this year, English first).
- Starts at $399; preorder that day, availability September 18.
- Sidebar mentions Apple announced a foldable "iPhone Duo".

wikis.title: Apple newsroom: Apple Watch Series 12 and Health Sensing System
wikis.summary: Apple's press release (part 1) introducing Apple Watch Series 12: heart rate sensing, HRV, readiness, finishes and availability.
wikis.body:
- Apple Watch Series 12 with new Health Sensing System and S11 chip ("Apple's most powerful wearable chip"); claims the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, based on a study of over 1,000 participants.
- Finishes: dark bronze, black, light gold, space gray aluminum; radiant gold and natural titanium; ceramic in pearl white and night blue. Aluminum models use Ceramic Shield 2, 60 percent tougher than previous Ion-X.
- Pre-order today, availability Friday, September 18.
- Heart rate measured every five seconds all day; new heart rate watch face complication. HRV measured up to 24 times more often, with recovery HRV and overall HRV; overnight vitals uses recovery HRV; new daytime vitals view.
- Readiness: 0-10 score using activity, training load, vitals, sleep; recommendation Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready or Go For It.
- Redesigned Health app later this year with Longevity tab and Health Age; Audio Intelligence features later this year; watchOS 27 brings Siri AI via Apple Intelligence.
- Quote from Kaiann Drance, VP Worldwide Apple Watch Product Marketing.

wikis.title: Apple Watch: overview, development and launch (Wikipedia part 1)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's overview of the Apple Watch line, its development from 2011 to 2014 and its April 2015 launch.
wikis.body:
- Line of smartwatches by Apple with fitness tracking, health features and wireless telecommunication; first released April 24, 2015 (pre-orders April 10, 2015). Estimated 267.6 million units sold (estimated, 2023); 4.2 million sold in Q2 of fiscal 2015; more than 115 million users estimated as of December 2022.
- A new generation each September, labelled "Series"; Series 6 split into Series 6 and budget SE (September 2020); in September 2022 Series 8 split into Series 8, SE 2 and the Ultra. LTE cellular from Series 3, 5G option from Series 11. Nike (aluminum) and Hermes (stainless steel) co-branded variants exist.
- Works with the paired iPhone but can use Wi-Fi alone; cellular models can make calls independently. As of September 2026 new watches ship with watchOS 27, requiring an iPhone running iOS 27 (iPhone 11 or later). Described as the only smartwatch fully supported for iPhone.
- Development: Jony Ive interested shortly after Steve Jobs's death in October 2011; Kevin Lynch hired March 2013 to lead the project; prototype was an iPhone strapped to the wrist; Force Touch added; UI redesigned three times.
- Introduced at the September 2014 event alongside iPhone 6 (Tim Cook's "one more thing"). Not branded "iWatch" (trademark owned by OMG Electronics in the U.S., Probendi in the EU, which sued Apple in July 2015). Early marketing as a fashion accessory, later shifted to health and fitness.

wikis.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4 announced with two-day battery
wikis.summary: MacRumors, 9 September 2026: Apple Watch Ultra 4 with S11 chip, health sensing system, larger battery, price and availability.
wikis.body:
- Wednesday 9 September 2026 (Tim Hardwick): Apple announced Apple Watch Ultra 4 with S11 chip, redesigned health sensing system and a larger battery Apple says gives two days of battery life.
- Up to 18 hours of workout tracking with full GPS and heart rate, or 45 hours in maximum extended workout mode.
- Health sensing: larger ECG electrode, ring of photodiodes, larger green LEDs; Apple claims the most accurate heart rate tracking of any wearable (study of hundreds of participants vs ECG chest strap). New Readiness score; redesigned Health app with Health Age, Longevity tab, Quest blood panel (50+ biomarkers, $119 in U.S.), VO2 max test with iPhone camera; coming later this year.
- S11 Audio Intelligence: Sound Recognition, Live Rewind (previous 15 seconds), Siri Recap (beta later this year, English first).
- Black and Natural titanium, new band colours and a new titanium Hermes band. Starts at $799; pre-order that day, available September 18.

wikis.title: Apple Watch Ultra (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's article on the Apple Watch Ultra line: hardware, release dates for each generation, and its reception.
wikis.body:
- Line of rugged sport smartwatches for endurance athletes and outdoor recreation, introduced September 2022. Releases: Ultra September 23, 2022; Ultra 2 September 22, 2023; Ultra 3 September 19, 2025; Ultra 4 September 18, 2026.
- Hardware: titanium case, 49 mm, flat-crystal display up to 2000 nits (3000 nits on Ultra 2), multi-band GPS (L1 and L5), orange Action button, emergency siren, all models with cellular, water temperature sensor, WR100 and EN13319, rated for diving to 40 m with a Depth app; Oceanic Plus dive app with Oceanic Worldwide.
- First generation battery 76% larger than Series 8: rated 36 hours (vs 18 on main line), about 60 hours in power saving mode.
- History: first Ultra unveiled September 7, 2022 with Series 8. Dec 2023 Series 9 and Ultra 2 pulled from U.S. sale over Masimo patent litigation, returned January 18, 2024 with blood oxygen disabled; September 9, 2024 black Ultra 2 and sleep apnea detection; August 14, 2025 update re-enabled blood oxygen for U.S. users (analysed on paired iPhone); Ultra 3 unveiled September 9, 2025.
- Reception: The Verge's Victoria Song called the first Ultra "a great first attempt at a rugged smartwatch".

wikis.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4 price and release date
wikis.summary: The Apple Post, 9 September 2026: Ultra 4 starts at $799, ships September 18, with battery and band details.
wikis.body:
- Starts at $799 in the U.S.; pre-orders open September 9 (2026) in more than 50 countries; in stores Friday, September 18.
- Natural and black titanium. New S11 chip and Health Sensing System: heart rate every five seconds, HRV data up to 24 times more frequently.
- Battery up to 50 hours normal use, 84 hours with Low Power Mode; Max Extended Workout mode up to 45 hours for some outdoor workouts.
- Bands: Trail Loop (dark umber, sand, burgundy), Alpine Loop (desert, dark olive, burgundy), Ocean Band now translucent silicone (translucent gray, kelp, black), new Hermes Grand H titanium band that can extend over a wetsuit.
- watchOS 27 releases Monday, September 14 for Series 9 and later, SE 3 and Ultra 2 and later; Apple Intelligence rollout the same day.

wikis.title: Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 guide (Macworld)
wikis.summary: Macworld guide to the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4: health monitoring, battery, prices and September 18 availability.
wikis.body:
- Both watches focus on health monitoring, Apple Intelligence and battery efficiency rather than redesigns; pre-order now, on sale September 18, 2026. Series 12 starts at $399 (unchanged), Ultra 4 at $799.
- New Health Sensing System: background heart rate every five seconds; HRV as often as every five minutes - 60 times and 24 times more frequently than Series 11.
- Readiness: 0-10 score updated during the day. S11 chip enables Siri AI and Audio Intelligence (Sound Recognition, faster Shazam, Live Rewind, Siri Recap); some features arrive later in 2026.
- Ultra 4 battery 42 to 50 hours normal, Low Power Mode 72 to 84 hours, workout modes up to 45 hours; satellite emergency SOS mentioned. Series 12 rated 24 hours, quicker charging; aluminium gains Ceramic Shield 2; ceramic models return. Both support 5G, Bluetooth 5.3, fast charging.
- Macworld notes rumours were broadly right that no major redesign would come.

wikis.title: AirPods 5 announced with improved noise cancellation
wikis.summary: MacRumors, 9 September 2026: AirPods 5 with Active Noise Cancellation from $129, and a $149 model with wireless charging case.
wikis.body:
- Wednesday 9 September 2026 (Tim Hardwick): Apple introduced AirPods 5, entry-level earbuds now with Active Noise Cancellation, from $129.
- Apple says up to 50% more external noise removed than AirPods 4; redesigned acoustic architecture, updated Adaptive EQ, improved Transparency mode. Adaptive Audio, Conversation Awareness, Live Translation (with compatible iPhone with Apple Intelligence).
- $149 model with Wireless Charging Case adds swipe volume controls on the stems; up to five hours listening with ANC, up to 22 hours with the case (supports Apple Watch and Qi chargers plus USB-C).
- Pre-order that day, available Friday, September 18.
- Sidebar: iOS 27 to release Monday, September 14.

wikis.title: The Verge on AirPods 5 announcement
wikis.summary: The Verge, September 2026: Apple announces AirPods 5 with open-ear active noise cancellation, at $129 and $149.
wikis.body:
- Apple announced AirPods 5, updating the AirPods 4 series first released in 2024; Apple says "best-in-class open-ear active noise cancellation".
- Redesigned with a new acoustic architecture, upgraded adaptive ANC with 50 percent better noise reduction than AirPods 4, and improved sound.
- A second model adds on-stem swipe volume control (first time in Apple's open-ear design) and a wireless charging case (supports Apple Watch and Qi chargers); up to five hours playback with ANC, one hour more than AirPods 4 with ANC.
- Pre-order today: $129 base; $149 with Wireless Charging Case ($30 less than the previous generation). Both available September 18th.
- Notes John Ternus was VP of hardware engineering when the original AirPods launched in 2016 and this is his first event as Apple's new CEO.

wikis.title: Apple newsroom: AirPods 5 with open-ear Active Noise Cancellation
wikis.summary: Apple's press release introducing AirPods 5: ANC, multiport acoustics, Siri AI, Live Translation, prices and availability.
wikis.body:
- AirPods 5 with what Apple calls "the industry's best" open-ear ANC, removing up to 50 percent more external noise than AirPods 4 with ANC; new multiport acoustic architecture, next-generation Adaptive EQ, improved Transparency mode, Adaptive Audio.
- Hands-free Siri AI, head gestures to respond, Live Translation; improved dust, sweat and water resistance.
- $129 for AirPods 5; $149 for AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case (longer battery life, on-stem volume control). Pre-order starting today, in stores Friday, September 18.
- Quote from Dave Pakula, VP Hardware Engineering: ANC brought to "our most affordable AirPods".

wikis.title: TechCrunch on AirPods 5 with improved ANC
wikis.summary: TechCrunch, 9 September 2026: AirPods 5 unveiled at Apple's Surprise and Shine event with stronger ANC, stem volume and Siri features.
wikis.body:
- Published 11:06 AM PDT, September 9, 2026. AirPods 5 unveiled at the "Surprise and Shine" event; Apple says they cut background noise 50% more than the previous generation.
- CEO John Ternus: ANC "is now standard across our entire AirPods lineup".
- Stem volume control (previously AirPods Pro only); H2-chip features: hands-free Siri and Apple Intelligence; updated Siri to roll out in beta with iOS 27, using personal context from messages, emails, photos.
- Improved Transparency mode, Adaptive Audio, Conversation Awareness. Up to five hours listening with ANC; case brings 22 hours.
- $129, or $149 with Wireless Charging Case; preorders begin today, arriving September 18.

wikis.title: Two iOS 27 features delayed past launch
wikis.summary: MacRumors, 11 September 2026: Messages suggestions and one-tap compromised-password fixes will not ship with iOS 27 on September 14.
wikis.body:
- Friday September 11, 2026 (Juli Clover): two features present in beta need more testing and will ship in a later iOS 27 version.
- Delayed: Apple Intelligence suggestions in Messages conversations (one-tap actions based on the discussion) and the option to automatically fix compromised passwords with a tap (Passwords app uses Apple Intelligence and Safari).
- Apple noted the delays on its iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate pages.
- iOS 27.1 is coming before October 23, when iPhone Duo ships with it pre-installed; the features could come then.
- iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 launch to the public Monday, September 14.

wikis.title: Apple releases iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 with Siri AI
wikis.summary: MacRumors, 14 September 2026: iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 released with Siri AI, Liquid Glass updates and Apple Intelligence features.
wikis.body:
- Monday September 14, 2026 (Juli Clover): Apple released iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, free, via Settings > General > Software Update.
- iOS 27 runs on all iPhones that run iOS 26 (iPhone SE 2, iPhone 11 series and later). iPadOS 27 on iPad Pro 2nd-gen+, iPad Air 4th-gen+, iPad mini 6th-gen+, A16 iPad.
- Siri AI: more capable, conversational Siri with personal context, app actions, onscreen awareness, world knowledge; may require sign-up in Settings; dedicated Siri app syncing via iCloud; Siri mode in Camera (Visual Intelligence); Write with Siri; new voices. Also Liquid Glass updates.
- Apple Intelligence needs iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max, all iPhone 16, 17 and 18 models; M-series iPads and A17 Pro iPad mini. No fees yet, but Apple "may start charging for higher usage in the future".
- Photos: Spatial Reframing, Extend, upgraded Clean Up; Safari: Organize by Topic, Notify Me; Describe a Shortcut; new Image Playground model.

wikis.title: Apple newsroom: iOS 27, macOS 27 and other platform updates available
wikis.summary: Apple's press release announcing availability of iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 and other updates with Siri AI, Apple Intelligence and parental controls.
wikis.body:
- Software updates available today across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 and other platforms.
- Siri AI: new Siri on the next generation of Apple Intelligence across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Vision Pro; rolling out as a beta in English, with French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish "coming in October". Siri mode in Camera, Visual Intelligence, Write with Siri, dedicated Siri app syncing conversations via iCloud.
- Apple Intelligence: Photos (Spatial Reframing, Extend, Clean Up), Image Playground (photorealistic, image metadata and upcoming SynthID support), Safari tab organization and Notify Me, Describe a Shortcut, Call Context.
- Child safety: new child-account setup flow, choose which apps kids can access, Ask to Browse, redesigned Screen Time with daily allowances for Entertainment, Games and Social Media.

wikis.title: Apple announces foldable iPhone Duo
wikis.summary: MacRumors, 9 September 2026: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo - design, displays, cameras, chip, battery.
wikis.body:
- Wednesday September 9, 2026 (Hartley Charlton): Apple announced the "iPhone Duo", with two screens and a foldable inner display; thinnest iPhone ever made when fully open.
- Machined polished titanium frame, Ceramic Shield back and Ceramic Shield 2 front, IP68; colours Star White and Night Sky. Touch ID in the side button; also unlocks with Apple Watch.
- Custom hinge of more than 100 precision components; multi-layer lamination with viscoelastic adhesives; titanium plate and carbon fiber support plates.
- Inner display 7.6 inches (50% larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max, 80% larger than 18 Pro); outer display 5.4 inches (90% of iPhone 18 Pro screen area). Apple Pencil support coming to both displays later this year. Nano texture and micro lens texture to reduce glare and crease visibility.
- Software: controls at the sides, vertical dock, partial-fold use, run two apps at once, new Standby mode.
- Cameras: 48MP Fusion main, 48MP Fusion ultra wide, 12MP Center Stage front on outer display, under-display FaceTime camera inside; dual capture, Duo FaceTime, Smart Take.
- A20 Pro, C2 modem (up to 50% faster than C1X, 5G mmWave in U.S., up to 15% less battery), up to 35% higher sustained performance than iPhone 17 Pro; eSIM only worldwide. Battery up to 31 hours video on inner display, 44 hours on outer.
- Elsewhere in MacRumors coverage, iPhone Duo launches October 23.

wikis.title: Apple newsroom: Apple unveils iPhone Duo
wikis.summary: Apple's press release introducing iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone, with displays, build, cameras and availability.
wikis.body:
- "Apple today introduced iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone." Opened, the thinnest iPhone ever, with a 7.6-inch inner Super Retina XDR display (50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max) and nano-texture finish; closed, a 5.4-inch outer display with 90 percent of iPhone 18 Pro's screen area. Same aspect ratio on both; ProMotion, Always On, 3000 nits peak outdoor brightness.
- Colours star white and night sky; grade 5 titanium, mirror polished, 3D-printed hinge cover. Ceramic Shield on the back, Ceramic Shield 2 on the front (3x better scratch resistance than previous generation). Precision hinge with magnet array.
- Pre-orders begin Friday, October 16, availability Friday, October 23.
- Touch ID in the side button, unlock with Apple Watch, Camera Control with Siri Camera mode; Apple Pencil with USB-C support later this year. A20 Pro powered.
- Cameras: 48MP Fusion Main (zero shutter lag, 24MP default, 2x optical-quality telephoto) and 48MP Fusion Ultra Wide; hidden inner FaceTime camera.
- John Ternus, Apple's CEO: "the most transformational change to iPhone since the original."

wikis.title: Apple announces first foldable iPhone starting at $1,999 (ABC News)
wikis.summary: ABC News, 9 September 2026: Apple unveils iPhone Duo at $1,999 alongside iPhone 18 Pro, at John Ternus's first event as CEO.
wikis.body:
- September 9, 2026: Apple announced its first foldable iPhone, "iPhone Duo", at its annual event and the debut of CEO John Ternus (took over September 1, 25 years at Apple, replacing Tim Cook).
- Folds open like a book into one continuous screen "80% larger" than the latest iPhone Pro; thinnest iPhone when open; supports Apple Pencil; can be unlocked with Apple Watch; used partially folded. Colours Star White and Night Sky.
- Price starts at $1,999; pre-order Oct. 16, in stores Oct. 23.
- Ternus: "Others have created a foldable that feels like two phones awkwardly stuck together."
- Foldables reached the market in 2018 and are a small fraction of smartphone sales.
- iPhone 18 Pro from $1,199, 18 Pro Max from $1,299; pre-order Sept. 12, in stores Sept. 18. Apple shares up 22% in six months vs 13% for the S&P 500.

wikis.title: Monster Hunter Wilds coming to Switch 2 on December 4 (Gameranx)
wikis.summary: Gameranx, 9 September 2026: Capcom dates Monster Hunter Wilds on Switch 2 for December 4 with 4-player local multiplayer.
wikis.body:
- September 9, 2026 (Ryan Parreno): Capcom announced on social media that Monster Hunter Wilds launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on Dec 4.
- Master Rank and the "massive expansion" Ascendance are also coming to Switch 2 in 2027.
- Local multiplayer for up to four players confirmed; a February rumor "proven correct".
- Article says it is unknown whether performance rumours are true; notes Capcom said it needed to learn the Switch 2 hardware first, and that 10 Capcom games are coming to Nintendo's platform this year.

wikis.title: Monster Hunter Wilds launches on Switch 2 in December (Nintendo Life)
wikis.summary: Nintendo Life, September 2026: release date, pricing, Game-Key Card, local and cross-platform play for Wilds on Switch 2.
wikis.body:
- Announced at the start of a Nintendo Direct: Monster Hunter Wilds arrives on Switch 2 on 4th December 2026 with "all title updates", local multiplayer for up to four hunters and "full cross-platform play" (a commenter notes no cross-save).
- Expansion Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance coming to the Switch 2 version in 2027.
- Digital pre-orders open 19th October 2026 at a discounted $29.99 USD until 19th December 2026, with pre-order bonuses and a Gold Edition.
- Game-Key Card release $39.99 USD with the base game and a Deluxe Pack voucher.
- A Prologue Demo will release before launch.

wikis.title: Monster Hunter Wilds lands on Switch 2 this December (Nintendo Wire)
wikis.summary: Nintendo Wire, 9 September 2026: Wilds confirmed for Switch 2 on December 4, 2026, with local ad hoc play and Ascendance in 2027.
wikis.body:
- September 9th, 2026 (Peter Glagowski): Capcom announced during that morning's Nintendo Direct that Monster Hunter Wilds hits Switch 2 on December 4th, 2026.
- Footage shows "surprisingly stable performance, although incredibly low-resolution visuals".
- Supports local ad hoc play between two players (per the article) like the 3DS games; crossplay is supported.
- Capcom confirmed in the reveal trailer that Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance will release on Switch 2 the same day as other platforms; planned 2027, no exact timeframe.

wikis.title: Playground says Forza Horizon 6 still coming to PS5 this year
wikis.summary: Gameranx, 8 September 2026: Playground Games says Forza Horizon 6 arrives on PS5 later this year, contradicting Tom Warren's claim of a 2027 slip.
wikis.body:
- September 8, 2026 (Ryan Parreno): Tom Warren of The Verge said "I'm not expecting to see Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 in 2026".
- Playground Games' Forza blog: "Forza Horizon 6 will be releasing on PS5 later this year"; players can wishlist it on the PlayStation Store.
- No PS5 release date given; article speculates it could land near GTA 6.
- Update: Warren doubled down on his 2027 claim in his newsletter.

wikis.title: Forza Horizon 6 (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's article on Forza Horizon 6, the Japan-set 2026 racing game by Playground Games: release, gameplay and development.
wikis.body:
- 2026 racing game by Playground Games, published by Xbox Game Studios; sixth Forza Horizon and fourteenth main Forza instalment. Set in a fictionalised Japan with a stylised Tokyo as main city.
- Released for Windows and Xbox Series X/S on 19 May 2026, "with a release for PlayStation 5 later in 2026".
- Largest open-world map in the franchise; Tokyo is the "most complex and intricate drivable space". Dynamic weather with seasons; wristband progression returns; launched with over 550 cars; eight garages; customisable "Estate" property; events include car meets, street racing and touge battles; "The Eliminator" battle royale mode.
- Developed with assistance from Turn 10 Studios; in December 2025 it was reported Turn 10 ended work on supporting Forza Motorsport (2023) to focus on FH6.
- Japan chosen because fans frequently requested it; art director Don Arceta cited its "unique culture" and contrast; seasonal changes include cherry blossoms.

wikis.title: Forza Horizon 6 PS5 delay rumors get response from Xbox
wikis.summary: ComicBook.com: Xbox and Playground reiterate FH6 is coming to PS5 in 2026 while Tom Warren still says it will not.
wikis.body:
- Forza Horizon 6 has been on Xbox Series X/S and PC since May (2026); PS5 owners are waiting. Xbox earlier said it would come to PS5 before the end of the year, but reports suggested otherwise.
- In a post on the official Forza website, Playground and Xbox reiterated the game is still releasing in 2026, without a specific date.
- The Verge's Tom Warren "doubled down", saying Xbox does not intend to release FH6 on PS5 in 2026.
- The article says the rest of 2026 is busy (Gears of War: E-Day, Control Resonant, Marvel's Wolverine, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Grand Theft Auto 6), and that Forza Horizon 5's PS5 port last year became one of the most successful games of the year on the hardware.

wikis.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time releases November 5 on Switch 2 (Gameranx)
wikis.summary: Gameranx, 8 September 2026: Nintendo confirms The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 on November 5, 2026.
wikis.body:
- September 8, 2026 (Ryan Parreno): at The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, Eiji Aonuma showed an extensive gameplay preview of the Switch 2 version; first look at Zelda, Sheik, Ganon.
- New: integration with Zelda Notes, giving potential rewards for daily activities and a guide.
- Release date confirmed: November 5, 2026. Remake announced "out of nowhere last June"; article frames it as this holiday's big release opposite GTA 6.

wikis.title: IGN: Zelda Ocarina of Time remake fully revealed, November 5
wikis.summary: IGN, updated 8 September 2026: Nintendo reveals the Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 and sets a November 5 launch.
wikis.body:
- Updated Sep 8, 2026 (Tom Phillips): Nintendo showed the Ocarina of Time remake and said it launches November 5 (2026), the same month as Grand Theft Auto 6.
- Remade from the ground up for Switch 2 with a new 3D visual style; manual jump, dash, quick item switching, motion-control aiming.
- New "Threads of Time" menu acts as quest log and tapestry of exploits; cutscenes fully voiced.
- Main structure largely unchanged, regions still separated by loading screens; extra areas teased in Castle Town with minigames in shops.
- Players can hum the Ocarina songs instead of button prompts; a physical Ocarina accessory will be available.
- Also shown: news on the upcoming live-action Legend of Zelda movie during the Legend of Zelda Nintendo Direct.

wikis.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time launches on Switch 2 on 5th November 2026 (Nintendo Life)
wikis.summary: Nintendo Life: release date and first gameplay details for the Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time.
wikis.body:
- Nintendo confirmed Ocarina of Time launches on 5th November 2026, with new gameplay shown.
- Changes: Link can jump with a button press; some shop and area transitions are seamless, but the Deku Tree dungeon and Hyrule Field still have transition screens, "apparently done to preserve the experience of the original"; Link can roll and dash in Hyrule Field with no apparent stamina gauge.
- Described as mostly a 1:1 remake, modernised with revamped environments and quality-of-life improvements.
- Ocarina playing: players can hum tunes in real life; a proper Ocarina will be made available.
- Zelda Notes for smartphone users: play the Ocarina, view accomplishments, take a knowledge quiz and more.

wikis.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake release date announced for Switch 2
wikis.summary: Nintendo Wire reports that Nintendo announced a November 5, 2026 Switch 2 release for the Ocarina of Time remake during the Zelda 40th Anniversary stream.
wikis.body:
- Nintendo announced the release date of the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time during "today's Zelda 40th Anniversary stream" (article dated September 8th, 2026, by Peter Glagowski).
- Release date: **November 5th, 2026**, on Switch 2, "just in time for the holiday season". The author says it leaves enough time away from Grand Theft Auto VI "to not overwhelm players with multiple consoles".
- The stream included a "decently lengthy first-look at some gameplay" and a cinematic trailer recapping the story, showing Young and Adult Link, Young Zelda, Ganondorf, Sheik and the Great Fairies. The author finds it faithful, though the higher-resolution look "starts to drift into uncanny valley territory".
- The trailer announced that first-print copies will include foil cover art, a nod to the original N64 release.
- No price yet; the author guesses $70 will be the final MSRP. A related item says the price may have leaked via the Australian eShop ahead of the Direct.
- Related headlines: rumor that Monolith Soft might be developing the remake; a Nintendo Direct doubleheader (Zelda on September 8, general Direct on September 9).

wikis.title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion shadow-drops on Switch 2
wikis.summary: Gameranx reports Square Enix shadow-dropped Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion on Switch 2 on September 9, 2026, likely without an upgrade path.
wikis.body:
- Gameranx (Ryan Parreno, September 9, 2026): Square Enix shadow-dropped Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion on Switch 2 "today".
- It is set before the events of Final Fantasy VII, as the original Crisis Core is a prequel.
- Square Enix's description: a remaster of the original Crisis Core with a complete HD graphics overhaul, a remastered soundtrack, a reimagined UI and an updated combat system.
- The remake originally released on the Switch alongside other platforms in 2022. The article says Square Enix "likely did not include an upgrade path" for Switch owners.
- Advice: play it first to get the full story on Zack Fair before the rest of the Final Fantasy VII trilogy.

wikis.title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion released for Switch 2 at $34.99
wikis.summary: Gematsu reports the Switch 2 version of Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion is out at a $34.99 launch price, rising to $49.99 after September 24.
wikis.body:
- Square Enix released a Switch 2 version of Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion at a launch discount price of **$34.99**; the price changes to **$49.99 after September 24**.
- Square Enix's overview: HD remaster of the Final Fantasy VII prequel; all graphics remastered in HD with renewed 3D models for characters and backgrounds; improved battle system; fully voiced dialogue in English and Japanese; a newly arranged soundtrack from original composer Takeharu Ishimoto.
- Story: Zack Fair, a young operative in Shinra's elite SOLDIER unit, with mentor SOLDIER 1st Class Angeal and hero Sephiroth, investigates the mass disappearance of SOLDIER operatives in Midgar.

wikis.title: Crisis Core FFVII Reunion surprise Switch 2 release, no upgrade path
wikis.summary: Nintendo Life reports the surprise Switch 2 release of Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion, on sale at $34.99 with no upgrade for existing Switch owners.
wikis.body:
- Revealed during the latest Nintendo Direct; available now on the eShop, on sale for $34.99 USD instead of $49.99 USD. "Unfortunately, there is no upgrade path for existing owners."
- Nintendo's PR describes it as a remaster of the action RPG set seven years before Final Fantasy VII: Zack Fair teams up with Sephiroth to investigate a fellow SOLDIER's disappearance. Switch 2 version has a complete HD overhaul of character models, UI and background, fully voiced dialogue in English and Japanese, an updated action combat system, and a newly arranged soundtrack by Takeharu Ishimoto.
- Previously released on the original Switch in December 2022.
- Digital pre-orders for Final Fantasy VII Revelation also went live on Switch 2: 24-hour Early Access is exclusive to Premium and Premium Plus Editions; Standard Edition pre-orders must be cancelled before payment is processed and re-ordered as PE/PPE to get it.
- Square Enix "has been building up excitement for Final Fantasy VII Revelation with all sorts of announcements in recent weeks".
- Reader comments (not the article) are largely critical of the missing upgrade path and digital-only availability.

wikis.title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion now on Switch 2
wikis.summary: RPGFan reports Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion is available on Switch 2 for $49.99 with a 30% launch discount until September 24, 2026, with no upgrade path or save compatibility.
wikis.body:
- RPGFan (Trent Argirov, September 9, 2026): announced during the latest Nintendo Direct with a short launch trailer.
- Price: $49.99 USD on the Nintendo eShop, with a 30% launch discount ($34.99 USD) until September 24th, 2026.
- No upgrade path between Switch 1 and Switch 2 versions, and save data is incompatible.
- Originally released in December 2022; improves several features of the original Crisis Core (2007) while leaving the story untouched: full HD graphics, redone character models and backgrounds, a rebalanced battle system, Japanese and English voice-over, and a newly arranged soundtrack by Takeharu Ishimoto.
- Official synopsis: Zack Fair, a SOLDIER operative, with Angeal and Sephiroth investigates mass disappearances of SOLDIER operatives.

wikis.title: Metroid Ravenous announced for Switch 2, January 28, 2027
wikis.summary: Gameranx reports Nintendo revealed Metroid Ravenous, the next 2D Metroid game, for Switch 2 on January 28, 2027.
wikis.body:
- Gameranx (Ryan Parreno, September 9, 2026): Nintendo revealed Metroid Ravenous, "the next 2D game in the Metroid franchise".
- Trailer: Samus says she was attacked by assailants she doesn't know and is fighting to survive on a moon; she is gravely injured but "willing to even feed on her enemies to survive". The trailer ends with Samus grabbing an opponent, her eyes glowing through a broken visor. The narration alludes to events in Metroid Dread.
- Release: Switch 2, January 28, 2027.
- A special edition and three amiibo were also revealed; details to come.

wikis.title: Metroid Ravenous announced, a side-scrolling sequel to Metroid Dread
wikis.summary: IGN reports Metroid Ravenous, a 2D follow-up to Metroid Dread, launches on Switch 2 on January 28, 2027 at $59.99 digital.
wikis.body:
- Announced during the Nintendo Direct on September 9, 2026 (IGN article updated Sep 9, 2026).
- Launch: Switch 2, January 28, 2027; $59.99 for a digital copy, the same as the upcoming Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
- Trailer quote: "I was attacked by unknown assailants and sustained grave injuries... My chances of getting off this moon are slim at best. Still... I will survive... Even if I have to feed on my enemies to do so. It's eat or be eaten."
- The name first surfaced this summer in a swiftly deleted ratings board listing in Brazil; fans speculated it referred to Dread's antagonist Raven Beak.
- IGN says it "appears to once again be the work of" Spanish studio MercurySteam, which made Metroid Dread and Metroid: Samus Returns.
- Dread and Ravenous sit at the end of the series chronology, years after Metroid Prime 4, so no direct continuation of that.
- amiibo: individual Samus and Chozo Statue figures; a third, Samus (Metroid Suit), is bundled with the Special Edition, which includes the game and a SteelBook case.
- IGN scored Metroid Dread 9/10.

wikis.title: Metroid Ravenous Nintendo store page
wikis.summary: Nintendo's US store page describes Metroid Ravenous for Switch 2, its amiibo and Special Edition.
wikis.body:
- Premise: Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter, is ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Players gather an arsenal, navigate corridors, hunt powerful bosses, and use "newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes"; strike quickly with beams, missiles and more.
- amiibo (sold separately unless noted; functionality details "at a later date"): Samus, Chozo Statue (larger than standard size), and Samus (Metroid Suit), which comes with Metroid Ravenous: Special Edition.
- Special Edition: physical version of the game, a SteelBook case, and the Samus (Metroid Suit) amiibo.
- Languages: Japanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Korean, Dutch, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Latin American Spanish, Canadian French, Brazilian Portuguese, American English.
- Page notes ratings and download size may not be finalized at preorder. Price and date are not in the extracted text.

wikis.title: Rumor: GTA 6 PC release might come sooner than expected
wikis.summary: Gameranx relays VGC's Andy Robinson saying the GTA 6 PC version might arrive sooner than expected.
wikis.body:
- Gameranx (Ryan Parreno, September 7, 2026): GTA 6 might not take a full year to reach PC after PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
- Andy Robinson on the VGC Podcast: "I do think they'll push the PC release up; there's a bit of noise about that... that perhaps the PC version might arrive sooner than some people might expect just because of everything that is going on. Maybe, you know, cloud is going to... be a thing."
- Background: the first Grand Theft Auto was made for PC; GTA 3 released on Windows a year after PlayStation 2.
- Article speculates Take-Two could approve a PC release less than six months in, depending on how much time Rockstar needs for the port.

wikis.title: Report: GTA 6 PC release could come sooner than expected
wikis.summary: Vice reports VGC's Andy Robinson claimed on the September 4 VGC podcast that GTA 6 could reach PC sooner than expected; Rockstar has not confirmed a PC version.
wikis.body:
- Claim: on the September 4 episode of the VGC podcast, Andy Robinson said there is "a bit of noise" about the PC version arriving sooner than expected. Vice says it is unclear whether he has a specific source.
- VGC also noted PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles will likely be "hard to come by" when the game launches in November, which could push Rockstar to move up PC.
- Rockstar has not confirmed a Steam version or PC date. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told Bloomberg in May that Rockstar "always starts on console" to serve the core consumer first; he gave no PC window.
- Red Dead Redemption 2 took approximately a year to reach PC after console.
- Vice does not expect a PC release soon: "Only time will tell."

wikis.title: GTA 6 PC release could come sooner than expected, VGC says
wikis.summary: gamer.org summarizes the VGC rumor of an earlier GTA 6 PC release, stressing Rockstar has announced no PC version and giving console price and past PC-gap context.
wikis.body:
- GTA 6 officially launches **November 19, 2026** on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; Rockstar has not announced a PC version, release window, Steam/Epic page or system requirements.
- VGC editor-in-chief Andy Robinson, on the September 4 VGC podcast, said he has heard "a bit of noise" about an earlier PC version and believes Rockstar will "push the PC version up". No window given; treated as "a credible industry rumor rather than confirmation".
- Console prices: Sony raised the US PS5 price to $649.99 (since April 2, 2026); Xbox raised prices effective August 1 by $100 (512GB) and $150 (1TB); the 1TB Xbox Series X starts at $799.99 in the US.
- Past gaps: GTA 5 PS3/Xbox 360 September 2013, PC April 2015 (roughly 19 months); RDR2 console October 26, 2018, PC November 5, 2019 (just over 12 months). RDR2 pattern would mean late 2027 for GTA 6; GTA 5's would mean well into 2028.
- Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said earlier in 2026 that PC can represent 45% to 50% of sales for a major game.
- Rockstar's August extended gameplay presentation reiterated the November 19 launch for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only.

wikis.title: Rumor: Marvel's Venom game still in development
wikis.summary: Gameranx relays NateTheHate saying Insomniac's unannounced Marvel's Venom game is still in development.
wikis.body:
- Gameranx (Ryan Parreno, September 7, 2026). An Insomniac ransomware leak revealed a Venom spin-off on their roadmap alongside Marvel's Wolverine; Insomniac has not confirmed it.
- Last year MAGG claimed Venom would release this year and Wolverine move to 2027. Earlier this year Miles Morales' voice actor said a Venom game (even with DLC) was planned before the passing of Tony Todd, who voiced the symbiote.
- NateTheHate: "Venom is very much still in development upon last check. As to when it'll be announced, I don't know."
- Article: raises questions about Venom's voice; the game "could still get cancelled" until Sony makes it official.

wikis.title: Insider says Insomniac's Venom game is still in development
wikis.summary: TheGamer reports NateTheHate's claim that Venom is not cancelled, plus unverified Reddit claims about its story.
wikis.body:
- Published Sep 5, 2026. NateTheHate posted: "Venom is very much still in development upon last check. As to when it'll be announced, I don't know."
- Background: in 2023 ransomware group Rhysida hacked Insomniac and stole 1.6 terabytes of data; it was leaked when Insomniac refused to pay. The leak included a roadmap listing a new Ratchet & Clank, Marvel's Spider-Man 3 and the Venom spin-off (slated for 2025 there). Insomniac never confirmed Venom.
- After Tony Todd's death most assumed cancellation. Miles Morales actor Nadji Jeter said "We were going to have a Venom game [...] but we lost Tony Todd"; Bloomberg's Jason Schreier replied "That isn't true" (ambiguous).
- A Reddit user claiming to be an Insomniac programmer gave unverified details: Eddie Brock as Venom, Oscorp break-in, Carnage as main villain, a playable trio of Eddie, Miles and Peter. TheGamer stresses none of it is verified.

wikis.title: Insomniac's Venom game still in development, it's claimed
wikis.summary: Insider Gaming reports NateTheHate's September 4, 2026 claim that Insomniac's Venom project is still in development.
wikis.body:
- Insomniac is reportedly still working on its unannounced Marvel's Venom project, per insider NateTheHate (post dated September 4, 2026): "Venom is very much still in development upon last check. As to when it'll be announced, I don't know."
- In Spider-Man 2, the symbiote is a cure for Harry Osborn's ailment, so Harry becomes Venom in Insomniac's universe.
- After Tony Todd's passing, Miles Morales' voice actor suggested the game had been canceled.
- Marvel's Wolverine is "slated for release in a little over a week": September 15 (2026). A Spider-Man 3 is planned.

wikis.title: Rumor: Squadron 42 content creator preview event in October
wikis.summary: Gameranx reports Squadron 42 Steam achievements surfaced and creators were invited to an October preview under strict NDAs; the game is delayed to second half of 2027.
wikis.body:
- Gameranx (Ryan Parreno, September 9, 2026). Squadron 42, Star Citizen spin-off, had its Steam achievements list revealed (ResetERA user Nerun); neither Cloud Imperium Games nor Valve confirmed a Steam release.
- Several content creators say they were invited to an October preview event. Unclear if games media are invited. Under the NDA, creators may capture CIG-approved moments and areas; most gameplay and the townhall meeting are under NDA; impressions are allowed but no footage unless approved; interviews uncertain.
- The article says CIG has delayed Squadron 42 to the second half of 2027 (IGN's piece reports Q2 2027). Skepticism warranted.

wikis.title: Squadron 42 delayed to 2027, Chris Roberts blames GTA 6
wikis.summary: IGN reports Cloud Imperium delayed Squadron 42 to Q2 2027, with Chris Roberts saying GTA 6 would swamp coverage.
wikis.body:
- Updated Aug 27, 2026. CEO Chris Roberts, in a blog post, said Squadron 42 will launch in **Q2 2027**, previously 2026 (announced at CitizenCon 2024, planned Q4 around IAE).
- Roberts: he does not want to launch "into the attention buzz saw of GTA 6"; outlets and creators will focus on it. Squadron 42 development began in 2014 (twelve years).
- CIG will preview Squadron 42 with content creators and early backers in October and use it to announce release plans, with a concrete date "shortly" afterwards.
- Cast listed: Gary Oldman, Mark Hamill, Henry Cavill, Andy Serkis, Ben Mendelsohn, Mark Strong. Star Citizen crossed $1 billion in funding earlier this year and still has no release window.
- Follows a "disastrous" developer livestream over bugs in a new Star Citizen update.

wikis.title: Squadron 42 delayed to Q2 2027 over GTA 6 launch
wikis.summary: Tech4Gamers reports Cloud Imperium delayed Squadron 42 to Q2 2027, citing GTA 6, with October creator previews planned.
wikis.body:
- Squadron 42, Star Citizen's single-player offshoot, delayed to Q2 2027; it was meant to launch in 2026 and has been in development since 2014.
- CEO Chris Roberts announced it in a blog post, saying the decision was due to the looming GTA 6 launch: all outlets and creators will focus on GTA 6 even though it is not launching on PC this November.
- CIG aims to hold previews with content creators and some early backers in October and announce a concrete release date shortly after.
- Star Citizen and Squadron 42 have hit over $1 billion USD in crowdfunding this year. Some fans argue the game shouldn't be delayed for GTA 6 since crowdfunders already paid; others think CIG needs polish time (the article says this is fan opinion).
- A recent livestream showed even basic features such as gun reloading looking broken, with developers described as passive-aggressive and argumentative.

wikis.title: Xbox acquires publishing rights to Kojima Productions' PHYSINT
wikis.summary: Gameranx reports Xbox announced it will publish PHYSINT, replacing Sony as publisher.
wikis.body:
- Gameranx (Ryan Parreno, September 10, 2026): Xbox announced it acquired the publishing rights to Kojima Productions' PHYSINT. Called "XBOX's biggest win this year".
- Asha Sharma's blog: "Creators have choices... We're honored that Kojima-san has chosen XBOX to work with KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS on PHYSINT... This expands our relationship with XBOX beyond OD... we remain committed to redefining the action-espionage genre".
- Kojima visited Xbox's Redmond headquarters last April.
- PHYSINT was announced at a State of Play two years earlier with Sony as original publisher and financial backer; a stealth action game from the creator of Metal Gear.
- Xbox is also partnering with Kojima Productions to bring projects to movies and shows, closing "any Sony involvement" a decade after Sony helped launch his independent studio.

wikis.title: PHYSINT to be published by Xbox instead of Sony
wikis.summary: IGN reports Microsoft announced Xbox will publish Kojima's PHYSINT after PlayStation planned to cancel it, expanding the partnership to film and TV.
wikis.body:
- Updated Sep 10, 2026. Microsoft announced Xbox will publish Physint, described as a spiritual successor to Metal Gear Solid. Xbox continues to publish Kojima's horror game OD; the partnership expands to film and television. OD will release before Physint.
- Kojima on X: in mid-June this year Kojima Productions "unexpectedly received notice from PlayStation Studios that they would cancel the Physint project"; they spent three months finding a partner and chose Xbox. Development "is ongoing".
- Xbox CEO Asha Sharma (took over from the retiring Phil Spencer earlier this year) made Kojima a priority in her reset of Xbox, including console exclusives starting with Gears of War: E-Day this year and Clockwork Revolution in 2027. In July IGN reported OD was safe from the reset, which saw thousands lose jobs, studios go independent and projects cancelled.
- PlayStation statement: "we have made the difficult decision to step away from collaborating with Kojima Productions on its project Physint," citing three decades of cooperation.
- At the 2024 State of Play, PlayStation Studios boss Hermen Hulst announced it with Kojima, ending under a Columbia Pictures sign (owned by Sony Group).

wikis.title: ONYX: The Dark Grip, Bloober's handheld-only Switch 2 exclusive
wikis.summary: Gameranx reports ONYX: The Dark Grip, revealed at Nintendo Direct, is a handheld-only Switch 2 exclusive developed by Broken Mirror Games and published by Bloober Team.
wikis.body:
- Gameranx (Ryan Parreno, September 10, 2026): Bloober Team revealed its long-teased "Project M" Switch 2 exclusive as ONYX: The Dark Grip, a dark adventure game, in the recent Nintendo Direct.
- Developed by Broken Mirror Games, a Bloober subsidiary; Bloober publishes.
- Designed for Switch 2 hardware and playable only in handheld mode: touching the screen, tilting the console and blowing into the microphone.
- Gameranx calls it a possible spiritual successor to DS/3DS horror and puzzle games.

wikis.title: Onyx: The Dark Grip, new Bloober Team horror game for Switch 2
wikis.summary: Eurogamer reports Onyx: The Dark Grip, a handheld-only Switch 2 horror game from Bloober Team, revealed at the Nintendo Direct for 2027.
wikis.body:
- Published Sept. 9, 2026. Revealed at the Nintendo Direct by Bloober Team, "best known for the Silent Hill 2 Remake and Cronos: The New Dawn". Coming in 2027; no specific window yet.
- Touchscreen and tilt mechanics require handheld mode.
- Story: you control Holden, a man stuck in a fog-shrouded town after being "beckoned by a voice", exploring places and reading other people's minds.
- Eurogamer sees it as the studio returning to smaller-scope development after larger recent games, which were received rather well.

wikis.title: Broken Mirror Games reveals ONYX: The Dark Grip for Switch 2
wikis.summary: Bloober Team's press release: Broken Mirror Games revealed ONYX: The Dark Grip, a Switch 2 exclusive launching in 2027.
wikis.body:
- Bloober Team, September 10, 2026: Broken Mirror Games, "a co-development label from Bloober Team", revealed ONYX: The Dark Grip during Nintendo Direct, "an original dark adventure launching exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027". Tagline: "Become the Vessel. Become the God."
- "Built from the ground up exclusively for handheld play", turning the Switch 2 into part of the game.
- Players control two sides of one struggle: The Vessel, an ordinary man fighting to survive, and The God, the godlike entity possessing him.

wikis.title: Blizzard shadow-drops Warcraft III Forsaken Kingdom campaign at BlizzCon 2026
wikis.summary: IGN reports Blizzard released Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom, a new two-part prologue campaign, on September 12, 2026 after the BlizzCon opening ceremony.
wikis.body:
- Updated Sep 12, 2026. Blizzard shadow-dropped a new campaign for the 24-year-old RTS Warcraft 3.
- Forsaken Kingdom is a two-part prologue that can be bought standalone; live September 12, 2026 following the BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony.
- Part of the free 3.0 update for Warcraft 3 Reforged, which includes World Editor updates.

wikis.title: BlizzCon (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Blizzard Entertainment's annual convention, with history, ticket prices, cancellations and the 2026 edition.
wikis.body:
- Annual gaming convention by Blizzard Entertainment promoting Warcraft, StarCraft, Diablo, Overwatch, Hearthstone and Heroes of the Storm. First held October 2005; always at the Anaheim Convention Center, California. Infobox lists the latest edition as September 12, 2026.
- Features announcements, previews, Q&A, panels, costume contests, playable games; closing ceremonies have featured concerts (e.g. Metallica, Linkin Park, Muse). Blizzard held a similar event outside the U.S. 2004-2008 (Blizzard Worldwide Invitational).
- General admission prices: $120 (2005), $100 (2007-08), $125 (2009), $150 (2010), $175 (2011, 2013), $199 (2014-2018), $229 (2019), $299 (2023); BlizzCon 2026 $289 with early-bird $249.
- Benefit Dinner (2009-2019, 2026) donates net proceeds to Children's Hospital of Orange County; $499 for the BlizzCon 2026 Charity Night Addon.
- "BlizzCon is typically held every year. However, it has been cancelled six times in 2006, 2012, 2020, 2022, 2024, and 2025." BlizzCon 2024 was cancelled in April 2024 with no reason given; 2025 was cancelled in March 2025 with no explicit reason, with Blizzard stating its 2026 BlizzCon plans.

wikis.title: Warcraft III: Reforged gets Forsaken Kingdom campaign and graphics mode
wikis.summary: Game Informer reports Forsaken Kingdom, a 30-hour-plus campaign, plus a new graphics mode and quality-of-life updates, arrived for Warcraft III: Reforged on September 12, 2026.
wikis.body:
- Game Informer (Eric Van Allen, Sep 12, 2026): Warcraft III's first new campaign "for the first time in years", Forsaken Kingdom, arrives the same day for Reforged.
- Set amid the fall of Lordaeron; a new prologue covers the fallout after Arthas killed his father. Blizzard says it has over 30 hours of gameplay, some new gameplay additions and big quality-of-life upgrades.
- New graphics mode closer to the original direction; 24-unit group selection; additional World Editor improvements; a new neutral hero, the Forsaken Paladin.
- Out now for Warcraft III: Reforged owners.

wikis.title: Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom (Blizzard News)
wikis.summary: Blizzard's announcement of the Forsaken Kingdom campaign, its bundles, and its link to World of Warcraft: Forever launching November 4, 2026.
wikis.body:
- Forsaken Kingdom: a new campaign for Warcraft III: Reforged beginning in the ruins of Lordaeron and leading into the first days of World of Warcraft; follows the Forsaken freeing themselves from the Scourge, led by heroes such as Sylvanas Windrunner, establishing a foothold in the Undercity.
- Contents: a prologue, three campaign chapters, a neutral Forsaken Paladin hero unit. The Definitive Edition update adds performance and graphical improvements at no cost to existing Reforged owners.
- Purchase on Battle.net Shop: Forsaken Kingdom add-on (requires Reforged); Reforged; Forsaken Kingdom combo; limited-time Warcraft Forever Collection (Reforged, Forsaken Kingdom, World of Warcraft: Forever Skyborne Epic Pack, 30 days of WoW Game Time, extras), available through January 11, 2027.
- World of Warcraft: Forever continues shortly after this campaign, a reimagined original Azeroth launching **November 4, 2026**; included with WoW subscription or Game Time; digital packs unlock the Skyborne race, Zephras Isle start, Beta access, early name reservation, cosmetics.

wikis.title: Overwatch teases Hero 55, an Omnic hero, at BlizzCon 2026
wikis.summary: IGN reports Blizzard slipped a first look at Hero 55, an unnamed Omnic with a trench coat, hat and umbrella, into its 2026 roster image after revealing Doctrine.
wikis.body:
- Updated Sep 12, 2026. After revealing Doctrine (vampire-themed Support Hero), Blizzard posted the full 2026 hero roster: Doctrine joins Jetpack Cat, Anran, Emre, Dmon, Mizuki, Shion, Domina and Sierra, with a never-seen Omnic on the far right.
- Hero 55 is yet unnamed: an Omnic with a robotic trench coat, a hat and what seems to be an umbrella weapon. Fans dubbed him a "Sherlock Holmes Omnic". Blizzard had mostly shown only silhouettes before; the design differs from the one at the February 2026 Spotlight but the general look stays.
- Doctrine launches with Season 5 on October 6; Dokiwatch returns; big Sombra and Roadhog reworks planned. Game director Aaron Keller teased the team's February 2027 spotlight, "aiming for peak Overwatch".

wikis.title: Overwatch reveals best look yet at Hero 55
wikis.summary: Game Rant reports Overwatch's updated 2026 roster image at BlizzCon 2026 shows Hero 55, a support Omnic, and recaps Doctrine and Season 5.
wikis.body:
- Published Sep 13, 2026. Hero 55 is officially a support character, an Omnic in a fedora, suit and long coat, holding an umbrella; still unnamed, with a full reveal "later this year". Fans had worried after Blizzard quietly altered his silhouette (shorter coat, flatter collar, no eye glow); the new artwork looks flashier and what looked like a cane is an umbrella.
- In February Blizzard announced sweeping changes, dropping the "2" from the name, confirming 10 new heroes across the year and more narrative focus.
- Doctrine: Doomfist's ally, vampire-inspired support with a scepter that heals allies and damages enemies, bat drones that heal and speed-buff attacks, and darkness-rush and flight movement.
- Season 5 also reworks Sombra and Roadhog. Overwatch is giving away a free Mythic skin for BlizzCon.

wikis.title: Overwatch's BlizzCon 2026 reveals (Blizzard News)
wikis.summary: Blizzard's rundown of Overwatch at BlizzCon 2026: Doctrine as Hero 54, a Hero 55 tease, a new map, reworks, Mythic gift and events.
wikis.body:
- Doctrine, vampire-inspired Support Hero and Doomfist ally (Hero 54), playable in a Hero Trial through September 14 before joining in Season 5, which concludes the Reign of Talon year-long story arc. A Hero 55 tease hints at 2027.
- New Escort map Watchpoint: Grímsvötn, an Icelandic volcano prison.
- Season 5: major reworks for Sombra (moving from Damage to Support) and Roadhog; Dokiwatch continues.
- Play one game after the Opening Ceremony for a BlizzCon Mythic Gift, redeemable for one complete Mythic bundle from Seasons 1-14; earn and redeem by October 5.
- Overwatch World Cup finals with the top eight teams; LE SSERAFIM at the closing ceremony and YOASOBI on World Cup Day 2. QuestWatch live TTRPG one-shot with Matt Mercer on September 13, 12 pm PT, with a Make-A-Wish charity auction.
- Overwatch Spotlight returns February 2027 with a roadmap.

wikis.title: StarCraft devs promise new game will release in 2030
wikis.summary: IGN interviews StarCraft developers at BlizzCon 2026 on why they announced a firm 2030 date for the open-world shooter and what gameplay it teases.
wikis.body:
- Updated Sep 12, 2026. The new StarCraft is an open-world shooter (not an RTS) set to launch in **2030**. Dan Hay (GM & VP of StarCraft) and AnaLee Haertling (Associate Director) said a firm date keeps them "honest" and is "a rallying cry"; Hay confirmed 2030 is "solid".
- Hay could not say how long it has been in development ("in my head... probably about 25 years").
- Aims for an authentic, recognizable world, welcoming to new players. Themes: a rough, difficult world of warfare and factions that don't always get along; "boots on the ground, down in the muck and the dirt".
- Hay recalled a 10-foot-tall Hydralisk snapping at him, and a barracks deployment that changes your perspective. Possible gameplay: explore, discover, disrupt, and using one enemy as a "tool" against another ("The enemy of my enemy is a tool to be used"). Hay said "a lot of biomass" was in his mind but he was holding some things back.

wikis.title: Blizzard's StarCraft open-world shooter revealed, coming 2030
wikis.summary: Kotaku reports Blizzard revealed a new open-world StarCraft shooter, simply titled StarCraft, for 2030, with only a cinematic shown.
wikis.body:
- Blizzard revealed a brand new StarCraft open-world shooter, entitled StarCraft, which "you won't be able to play... until 2030".
