- No gameplay or big details; the cinematic showed recruits training for war against the Swarm, then dropping into a combat zone; character Holt's weapon jams and a shot of his ruined suit implies he died.
- Last StarCraft game: StarCraft: Remastered (2017); last new one: StarCraft 2: Wings of Liberty (2010).
- A shooter had been rumored for years, back to the cancelled Ares project in 2019 and a 2024 job listing led by Dan Hay, former Ubisoft developer and Far Cry 5 director.
- Sidebar headlines: BlizzCon may not go back to annual; Blizzard asked about Diablo 5 being confirmed for PC but StarCraft not.

wikis.title: Blizzard reviving StarCraft as open-world shooter, spring 2030
wikis.summary: Engadget reports Blizzard's BlizzCon 2026 cinematic reveal of StarCraft, a story-driven open-world shooter due spring 2030.
wikis.body:
- At BlizzCon 2026 Blizzard dropped a cinematic trailer for a game simply titled StarCraft, described as a "story-driven open-world shooter". Release: spring 2030.
- Last release was the 2017 remaster of the original; StarCraft 2 came out 16 years ago. Blizzard said "it's about damn time"; "From the farthest reaches of the stars, a new mission calls."
- Earlier StarCraft shooters rumored for years died in development; the last such talk was in 2024.

wikis.title: Insomniac says Wolverine's scent trail isn't always on
wikis.summary: IGN reports the 'fart gas' debate over Marvel's Wolverine's scent trail, with Insomniac's community director saying it is not always on.
wikis.body:
- Updated Sep 12, 2026. After Marvel's Wolverine reviews, Gene Park (Washington Post) called the scent trail "fart gas" and posted (Sep 10, 2026) that it stays on after turning off navigation options.
- Insomniac's accessibility list has a "Chase Assist" (reduced target movement speed in chases) that does not disable the trail; other navigation toggles do not either.
- James Stevenson, director of community and marketing: "The scent trail isn't always on... It represents Logan's canon mutant super senses and elite tracking ability. It only is there when he's tracking a specific scent / sound (a person, whisky, or another clue scent) - story/mission moments or when he catches whiff of a collectible." For collectibles you must first get close enough to pick up the sound or scent.
- Critics say the trail holds the player's hand; some suggested an R3 trigger. IGN's review scored 6/10.

wikis.title: Wolverine community director defends the scent trail
wikis.summary: TheGamer reports Insomniac's James Stevenson explained the Wolverine scent trail after review-driven criticism.
wikis.body:
- Published Sep 11, 2026. Reviews went live the day before with a 78 on Metacritic, "a bit disappointing" per TheGamer; the reviewer says they came away more positive.
- Contention: the scent trail, a blue smell line dubbed "fart gas trail", guides players to main objectives and collectibles.
- Community director James Stevenson said on Twitter it is not always on and "represents Logan's canon mutant super senses and elite tracking ability"; it appears only when tracking a "specific scent/sound" for story moments or when he "catches whiff of a collectible", and you must get near a collectible to pick up its scent.
- Author: fine for main objectives (like a marker) but "goes a little far with collectibles". First official Insomniac response since reviews dropped.
- Game rated Mature 17+.

wikis.title: Insomniac community director responds to Marvel's Wolverine scent trail discourse
wikis.summary: OpenCritic teaser of a TheGamer article on Insomniac's community director defending Marvel's Wolverine's scent trail after mixed reviews.
wikis.body:
- Source: TheGamer (written by George Foster), dated September 11, 2026, syndicated on OpenCritic (teaser only; full article is at TheGamer).
- Marvel's Wolverine's scent trail (also called the "fart gas trail") has been "explained and defended" by Insomniac Games' community director.
- Reviews for "PlayStation's biggest game in years" went live the day before; the game scored 78 on Metacritic, described as not bad but not what everyone expected. The author reviewed it more positively than some.
- The scent trail draws a blue smell line that guides the player to main objectives and collectibles; the handholding is a main point of contention.
- Insomniac community director James Stevenson was tagged on Twitter and asked whether the scent trail can be turned off.
- Sidebar on the page lists Marvel's Wolverine at 79 (Sep 15) among available games.

wikis.title: Shop iPhone Duo on Apple's store
wikis.summary: Apple store page listing iPhone Duo pre-order timing, storage prices and eSIM FAQs.

- iPhone Duo: pre-order starting at 5:00 am PT on 10.16; available starting 10.23.
- Colors listed: Night Sky and Star White.

wikis.title: Apple: pre-orders for iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5
wikis.summary: Apple newsroom update on pre-order and availability dates and financing options for iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12/Ultra 4, AirPods 5, Mac mini and Mac Studio.

wikis.title: Buy iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB Silver (6.9-inch)
wikis.summary: Apple store page for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup with storage/color prices, carrier trade-in offers and eSIM FAQs.
wikis.body:
- Product page for the 6.9-inch iPhone 18 Pro Max, 256GB Silver, unlocked.
- Colors: Silver, Black, Glacier, Burgundy.
- Storage sizes: 256 GB, 512 GB, 1 TB, 2 TB. Listed prices: 256 GB $1,199.00-$1,299.00; 512 GB $1,399.00-$1,499.00; 1 TB $1,799.00-$1,899.00; 2 TB $2,499.00 (variation appears across listings).
- Carrier deals with AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon: save up to $1200 (two carriers) or $1020 (third) for an eligible trade-in in any condition. "Connect on your own later" option is offered.
- iPhone 18 Pro models purchased in the U.S. or Puerto Rico have no physical SIM tray and activate only with eSIM.
- Apple-purchased iPhones are unlocked in most cases; carrier installment plans lock the phone until paid in full.

wikis.title: MacRumors: Apple announces iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
wikis.summary: MacRumors report of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max announcement: displays, A20 Pro, battery, variable-aperture camera, colors, prices and availability.
wikis.body:
- Published Wednesday September 9, 2026 by Joe Rossignol.
- Looks very similar to iPhone 17 Pro; iPhone 18 Pro has a 6.3-inch display, Pro Max 6.9-inch. Smaller Dynamic Island that can show up to three Live Activities.
- A20 Pro on TSMC's 2-nanometer process: 6-core CPU, 7-core GPU, 32-core Neural Engine; sustained performance up to 40% faster than A19 Pro.
- Battery: iPhone 18 Pro matches iPhone 17 Pro Max at up to 24 hours typical usage; Pro Max up to 30 hours ("biggest generational leap in battery life ever"). Pro charges to 50% in 15 minutes. Vapor chamber is three times as large as in iPhone 17 Pro.
- 48-megapixel Fusion main camera with variable aperture (six laser-cut blades; ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8, ƒ/4.0), new sensor, computational imaging pipeline, Photographic Styles with texture and grain controls, 4K Dolby Vision Time-lapse, new "Pro controls" (aperture, shutter speed, white balance, histogram).
- Colors: Black, Silver, Glacier, Burgundy.
- U.S. pricing: iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, Pro Max at $1,299; first time a 2TB option is available for both.
- Pre-orders begin Saturday, September 12; launch Friday, September 18.
- eSIM-only models in Bahrain, Canada, Guam, Japan, Kuwait, Mexico, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, U.S. and U.S. Virgin Islands; SIM tray elsewhere including the U.K. and Europe.
- New Silicone Cases, TechWoven Cases, Crossbody Straps, FineWoven Wallets and a Wrist Strap.

wikis.title: iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, Pro Max at $1,299
wikis.summary: MacRumors piece on iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max pricing, a $100 increase over the previous models.
wikis.body:
- Published Wednesday September 9, 2026 by Hartley Charlton.
- Pricing starts at $1,199 (Pro) and $1,299 (Pro Max), both with 256GB base storage.
- A $100 increase over equivalent iPhone 17 Pro/Pro Max pricing, matching Bloomberg's Mark Gurman's prediction and smaller than many analysts had floated.
- Both models offer a 2TB option for the first time, above the previous 1TB ceiling, at added cost.
- Apple Upgrade program starts at $34.99 a month over 24 months, lower with an eligible trade-in; trade-in of iPhone 14 or newer gets up to $1,200 off.
- Context: months of speculation about steeper hikes, after cost increases across Mac, iPad and home lines earlier in 2026 tied to the global memory shortage.
- Related items listed: foldable "iPhone Duo" announced the same day; iOS 27 release for compatible iPhones on Monday, September 14; the event was called "Surprise and Shine".

wikis.title: Shop Apple Watch Series 12 on Apple's store
wikis.summary: Apple store page for Apple Watch Series 12 listing case, size and band combinations and FAQs.
wikis.body:
- Apple Watch Series 12, in GPS and GPS + Cellular, 42mm and 46mm cases.
- Case finishes seen: Night Blue Ceramic, Pearl White Ceramic, Light Gold Aluminum, Black Aluminum, Space Gray Aluminum, Dark Bronze Aluminum, Natural Titanium, Radiant Gold Titanium.
- Bands include Solo Loop, Braided Solo Loop, Sport Band, Sport Loop, Modern Buckle, Magnetic Link, Nike and Pride/Unity editions.
- Prices visible in the page text: $399, $799, $249 (not tied to specific models in the extracted text).
- FAQ: band sizing (Sport Band has one size in the box; Solo Loop bands need the sizing guide), GPS vs GPS + Cellular.

wikis.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4 (Apple product page)
wikis.summary: Apple's product page for Apple Watch Ultra 4 covering battery, Health Sensing System, readiness, HRV, Siri AI and running features.
wikis.body:
- Battery: up to 50 hours normal use; up to 45 hours of Max Extended Workout tracking; fast charge 15 minutes for up to 18 hours of use.
- New Health Sensing System (optical and electrical sensors, larger green LEDs) with the S11 chip: "the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable"; background heart rate every five seconds, HRV as often as every five minutes (60x more frequent background heart rate and 24x more frequent HRV than Ultra 3).
- New readiness score determined each morning from activity, vitals and sleep; redesigned Health app with Health Age ("Coming late 2026").
- Siri AI rolling out in English; some Audio Intelligence features "coming in beta late 2026".
- Built-in satellite communications; rugged titanium case (natural and black), sapphire crystal display, MIL-STD-810H, WR100 (scuba to 40 meters), IP6X dust resistant; Action button; new Siri Modular watch face.
- Running features: running power and cadence, Custom Workouts, Heart Rate Zones, Pacer, Race Route, Automatic Track Detection, enhanced Workout Buddy.

wikis.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4: official price, specs and what changed from leaks
wikis.summary: Smartwatch Insight article updated after the September 9, 2026 announcement, comparing leaks to Apple's confirmed Watch Ultra 4 specs.
wikis.body:
- By Sunil Bhatt, dated 2026-09-18; update note: Apple unveiled Watch Ultra 4 on September 9, 2026 at its "Surprise and Shine" event.
- Price held at $799 (a fourth straight generation); in stores Friday, September 18, 2026; pre-orders opened September 9.
- Leaks that did not happen: 15% thinner case (DigiTimes), real-time blood pressure alerts, Touch ID, second Action Button. Case is 49x44x12mm, same as Ultra 3; weight 63.0g (+1.4g).
- Confirmed: S11 chip; Health Sensing System; battery up to 50 hours normal, 84 hours Low Power Mode; outdoor workout battery 18/25/45 hours (standard/Extended/Max Extended); LTPO OLED display 3000 nits; 100m water resistance; GLONASS dropped; watchOS 27; existing Ultra bands compatible.
- New: Readiness daily 0-10 score with Recover / Pace Yourself / Ready / Go For It; Audio Intelligence (Sound Recognition, Live Rewind, Siri Recap, Shazam) with Live Rewind and Siri Recap in beta later this year, requiring an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone 16 or later. HRV readings up to 24x more frequent.
- New band colors (Trail Loop, Alpine Loop, Ocean Band translucent) and an Apple Watch Hermès Ultra 4 with a Grand H titanium band.
- MicroLED and glucose monitoring not this generation.

wikis.title: Buy AirPods 5 on Apple's store
wikis.summary: Apple store page for AirPods 5 with pricing, model comparison and FAQs.
wikis.body:
- AirPods 5 $129.00; AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case $149.00 (adds force sensor with volume swipe and longer battery life). Active Noise Cancellation on both.
- Up to 1.5x more ANC than AirPods 4 with ANC; Adaptive Audio, Transparency, Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking; Live Translation and Siri AI; no Lossless Audio, heart rate sensing or hearing health features.
- Listening time with ANC: up to 4 hours (standard case), up to 5 hours (Wireless Charging Case, which works with Apple Watch charger and Qi chargers and has a Find My speaker).
- No USB-C cable or power adapter included.
- Live Translation supported languages include Mandarin (Simplified and Traditional), English (UK, US), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish; needs an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone.
- Comparison: AirPods Pro 3 $249 with up to 3x more ANC than AirPods 5, heart rate sensing and hearing features, up to 8 hours.

wikis.title: TechRadar: AirPods 5 announced with open-ear ANC and $129 price
wikis.summary: TechRadar deals article on AirPods 5 features, pricing and pre-order deals.
wikis.body:
- Last updated 10 September 2026, by Mackenzie Frazier. AirPods 5 unveiled at the 2026 Apple September Event, available to pre-order.
- Apple claims "industry-leading" ANC in an open-ear design via a new acoustic architecture, 50% more noise reduction than AirPods 4, richer sound with more dynamic personalized spatial audio, a more durable design, Live Translation, hands-free Siri AI, up to five hours playback with ANC.
- Price: $129 / £119; version with Wireless Charging Case and on-stem volume control $149 / £139.
- Ships and in stores Friday, September 18, along with iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.
- Deals: Apple pre-order $129 with free engraving; Amazon and Best Buy in stock at $129 (US); UK Apple £119 with free engraving, Argos in stock.
- Larger discounts expected around Amazon's October Prime Day and November Black Friday.

wikis.title: Apple unveils Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro
wikis.summary: Apple press release announcing the new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro, its performance, pricing and availability.
wikis.body:
- Apple press release, dated August 25, 2026. Quote from Johny Srouji: "Mac mini has always been our most versatile Mac." Positioned for "always-on, deskside agentic computing".
- Announced August 25, 2026: new Mac mini with the all-new M6 chip or M5 Pro. Pre-orders start August 25; available/arriving September 22.
- M6: 12-core CPU (two more cores than before), 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core (first on Mac mini), dual 16-core Neural Engine; up to 4x faster AI, 2x faster graphics and storage, 40 percent faster CPU (vs. M4 model). 16GB unified memory configurable to 32GB, memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s.
- M5 Pro: up to 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU; up to 64GB unified memory.
- Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, 2.5Gb Ethernet standard with a 10Gb option; macOS 27 with Siri AI.
- U.S. pricing: M6 from $899 ($799 education); M5 Pro from $1,699 ($1,599 education).

wikis.title: MacRumors: Apple announces new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro
wikis.summary: MacRumors report on the 2026 Mac mini specs, ports and prices.
wikis.body:
- MacRumors, Tuesday August 25, 2026, by Joe Rossignol.
- Announced August 25, 2026: new Mac mini with the all-new M6 chip or M5 Pro. Pre-orders start August 25; available/arriving September 22.
- M6: 12-core CPU (two more cores than before), 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core (first on Mac mini), dual 16-core Neural Engine; up to 4x faster AI, 2x faster graphics and storage, 40 percent faster CPU (vs. M4 model). 16GB unified memory configurable to 32GB, memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s.
- M5 Pro: up to 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU; up to 64GB unified memory.
- Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, 2.5Gb Ethernet standard with a 10Gb option; macOS 27 with Siri AI.
- U.S. pricing: M6 from $899 ($799 education); M5 Pro from $1,699 ($1,599 education).
- M6 memory bandwidth 170GB/s (153GB/s on M5). M5 Pro configs: 15-core CPU/16-core GPU and 18-core CPU/20-core GPU. M6 up to 2TB SSD and 32GB; M5 Pro up to 8TB and 64GB.
- Same design as 2024 models, silver only; M6 has Thunderbolt 4, M5 Pro Thunderbolt 5; up to three external displays.
- The previous Mac mini started at $599, rose to $799 with June price increases; the equivalent M6 configuration starts at $899.

wikis.title: 9to5Mac: Apple announces new Mac mini, everything new
wikis.summary: 9to5Mac rundown of the M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini, benchmarks and pricing.
wikis.body:
- 9to5Mac, Aug 25 2026, by Chance Miller. First Mac mini update in nearly two years.
- Announced August 25, 2026: new Mac mini with the all-new M6 chip or M5 Pro. Pre-orders start August 25; available/arriving September 22.
- M6: 12-core CPU (two more cores than before), 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core (first on Mac mini), dual 16-core Neural Engine; up to 4x faster AI, 2x faster graphics and storage, 40 percent faster CPU (vs. M4 model). 16GB unified memory configurable to 32GB, memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s.
- M5 Pro: up to 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU; up to 64GB unified memory.
- Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, 2.5Gb Ethernet standard with a 10Gb option; macOS 27 with Siri AI.
- U.S. pricing: M6 from $899 ($799 education); M5 Pro from $1,699 ($1,599 education).
- M6 is Apple's first 2nm chip: 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, 6 efficiency cores. Bandwidth 170GB/s vs 153GB/s (M5) and 120GB/s (M4). M5 Pro up to 64GB at 307GB/s.
- Apple benchmarks: M6 up to 13.5x faster LM Studio prompt processing vs M1 (4.8x vs M4); M5 Pro up to 8.5x vs M2 Pro (4x vs M4 Pro).
- Base M6 configuration: 256GB storage, 16GB memory at $899, a $100 increase over the previous base configurations.

wikis.title: Apple introduces Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
wikis.summary: Apple press release on the new Mac Studio: chips, AI performance, memory, connectivity, pricing and availability.
wikis.body:
- Press release dated August 25, 2026. Pre-order starts that day; availability begins September 22.
- M5 Max: 18-core CPU, up to 40-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, up to 128GB unified memory. M5 Ultra: up to 36-core CPU, up to 80-core GPU, up to 512GB unified memory.
- Up to 4.3x faster AI performance, up to 2x faster storage, 1.8x faster graphics, 1.3x faster CPU. Thunderbolt 5 allows clustering multiple Mac Studio systems for up to 3x faster distributed AI inference. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 for the first time.
- U.S. pricing: M5 Max from $2,499 ($2,299 education); M5 Ultra from $5,499 ($5,099 education). Apple Upgrade lease: M5 Max from $48.99/month (36 months), M5 Ultra from $110.10/month (36 months).
- Quote from Johny Srouji: "our most powerful Mac ever."

wikis.title: Tim Cook announces what is likely his final Apple product
wikis.summary: MacRumors on Tim Cook's X post announcing the new Mac mini, likely his last as CEO before John Ternus takes over.
wikis.body:
- MacRumors, Tuesday August 25, 2026, by Tim Hardwick.
- Cook posted on X: "The new Mac mini is here. Small in size. Big on performance."
- Cook hands over to incoming CEO John Ternus on September 1; per Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the Mac mini will probably be the final new product under Cook. Later products (iPhone 18 Pro, first foldable, "iPhone Ultra") become Ternus's to unveil; the fall iPhone event is expected September 9.
- Cook took over from Steve Jobs 15 years ago this week; he stays as executive chairman, dealing with policymakers and regulatory pressure.
- The Mac mini was announced by press release with no keynote.

wikis.title: Macworld: new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
wikis.summary: Macworld guide to the 2026 Mac Studio: specs, price changes, release date.
wikis.body:
- Updated Aug 25, 2026, by Karen Haslam. Announced August 25, 2026; shipping September 22, 2026, but 512GB unified memory configurations arrive in "late October".
- Replaces the M4 Max / M3 Ultra model of March 2025. M5 Max 18-core CPU, up to 40-core GPU; M5 Ultra 36-core CPU, 80-core GPU; Neural Accelerators in every GPU core.
- Claims: up to 1.3x CPU, 1.8x graphics, 4.3x AI; M5 Ultra up to 33 streams of 8K ProRes 422; PCIe Gen 6-based SSDs up to 2x storage; N1 chip for Wi-Fi 7/Bluetooth 6; USB-C genlock; up to eight displays; Thunderbolt 5 clustering.
- Prices: M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,499 / £2,499; M5 Ultra 96GB/1TB $5,499 / £5,499.
- In June 2026 Apple raised the starting price by $500 (from $1,999 to $2,499); M3 Ultra rose $1,300 from $3,999 to $5,299 attributed to component costs, especially RAM. M5 Ultra is $200 above that and $1,500 above the previous Ultra at launch.
- Macworld warns chip and component shortages may constrain high-memory models.

wikis.title: Audio-Technica ATH-AL5NC open-back wireless headphones
wikis.summary: Engadget on Audio-Technica's $279 ATH-AL5NC open-back Bluetooth headphones.
wikis.body:
- Engadget, Sept. 9, 2026, by Ian Carlos Campbell.
- $279, available today; includes 1.2m (3.9-foot) cable and carrying pouch.
- 53mm drivers, 24-bit/96kHz wireless via LDAC, also AAC and SBC; multipoint Bluetooth to two devices; up to 75 hours playback; 15-minute charge gives 8 hours.
- CONNECT app for presets, codecs, EQ and modes for low-latency gaming, noise reduction and sound-leakage reduction.
- Open-back design gives more natural sound and less heat buildup, with "minimal clamping pressure", but leaks more audio and cannot offer true noise cancellation.
- Compared with the $150 HyperX Cloud Alpha Air.

wikis.title: Audio-Technica launches ATH-M20xSTS streaming headset
wikis.summary: Hifi Pig news item on Audio-Technica's wired ATH-M20xSTS StreamSet headset.
wikis.body:
- Dated September 7, 2026. Added to Audio-Technica's StreamSet range; wired headset with boom microphone for streaming, gaming and content creation.
- Based on ATH-M20x monitor headphones; 40mm drivers.
- Built-in AT20 microphone on a flexible boom; lifting the arm mutes it.
- Weight approximately 230g; breathable mesh earpads; elliptical earcups.
- Detachable cable with four-pole 3.5mm plug; USB-A and USB-C adapters included; works with PCs, consoles and mobile devices; plug-and-play.
- Price £89 / €99; available to buy from 1 September.

wikis.title: Audio-Technica unveils budget ATH-M20xSTS headset
wikis.summary: Notebookcheck news on Audio-Technica's ATH-M20xSTS wired headset for streamers and gamers.
wikis.body:
- Notebookcheck, published 08/26/2026 by Jacob Fisher.
- ATH-M20xSTS wired headset expands the StreamSet range, builds on the ATH-M20x with 40mm dynamic drivers and a cardioid condenser microphone (AT20).
- Boom mic flips up to mute; mesh earpads; 230g; detachable 3.5mm TRRS cable with USB-A and USB-C adapters.
- Launches globally September 1 for $99 / €99 / £89. The wired design lacks wireless convenience.
- Related headlines mention the ATH-AL5NC open-back ANC headphones (09/10/2026).

wikis.title: Sony WH-1000XM4C (M4 2nd Gen) product page
wikis.summary: Sony Electronics store page for the WH-1000XM4C noise cancelling headphones.
wikis.body:
- Price $299.99; model WH-1000XM4C; colors Black, Lavender, Platinum Silver.
- Features: 1000X Series noise cancelling, premium sound with customization, up to 27-hour battery, multipoint connection, customizable touch controls, Sound Connect app.
- Weighs approximately 253g; foldable with carrying case.
- Estimated delivery Sep 23-24; 3-month Audible Premium Plus trial offer; free shipping; 0% APR with Affirm.

wikis.title: Sony introduces WH-1000XM4C, WH-CH730N and WH-CH530 headphones
wikis.summary: Sony Electronics press release of September 7, 2026 on three refreshed wireless headphone models.
wikis.body:
- Sony Electronics press release, San Diego, Sept. 7, 2026.
- WH-1000XM4C (M4 2nd Gen): refresh of the WH-1000XM4 with updated sound tuning, new 10-band equalizer, new lavender color. Available "this fall" in Black and Platinum Silver at $299.99 USD / $429.99 CAD; Lavender only at Sony and Amazon.
- WH-CH730N: noise cancelling, lightweight foldable design, improved call quality, up to 50 hours battery with ANC on, quick charge 3 minutes = 1 hour. Available from September 2026 at $179.99 USD / $249.99 CAD in Black, White, Pink, Blue; Oat only at Sony and Amazon.
- WH-CH530: up to 55-hour playback, quick charge 3 minutes = 1.5 hours, AI noise reduction for calls. From September 2026 at $69.99 USD / $99.99 CAD in Black, Cobalt, White, Pink; Coral and Mint only at Sony and Amazon.
- Also mentions a Sony x Hello Kitty collaboration and the WH-1000XM6 and 1000X THE COLLEXION. Quote from Masaaki Hori, VP of personal entertainment, Sony Electronics.

wikis.title: Sony revives WH-1000XM4 as the refreshed $300 WH-1000XM4C
wikis.summary: Engadget on Sony's WH-1000XM4C plus new WH-CH730N and WH-CH530 headphones.
wikis.body:
- Engadget, Sept. 7, 2026, by Billy Steele.
- WH-1000XM4C has the same design as the WH-1000XM4, ANC powered by QN1 chip, multipoint Bluetooth, latest sound profile, 10-band and gaming EQs, Quick Access. Battery 27 hours with ANC (three hours less than M4; four less with ANC off); quick charge 3 minutes = 1 hour. $300 "when it arrives this fall": $50 less than M4 in 2020 and $150 less than the WH-1000XM6.
- WH-CH730N (replaces WH-CH720N): redesigned ear cups, folding headband, up to 10 percent less noise, AI call noise reduction, up to 50 hours with ANC (75 without), background music mode, safe listening mode. Ships in September for $180 (black, blue, tan, white, pink).
- WH-CH530 (replaces WH-CH520): no ANC, battery up 5 hours to 55, 10-band and gaming EQ, $70 in September (black, purple, green, white, pink, coral).

wikis.title: Sony WH-CH730N wireless noise cancelling headphones (White) product page
wikis.summary: Sony Electronics store page for the WH-CH730N headphones.
wikis.body:
- Price $179.99; colors Beige, Black, Blue, Pink, White (White page). Also known as WH-CH730N, WH-CH735N.
- Dual Noise Sensor technology (twin mics in each earcup), Ambient Sound Mode with 20 levels, DSEE and 360 Reality Audio, multipoint connection, Sound Connect app.
- Approx. 207g, up to 50 hours playback with noise cancelling on, foldable.
- Estimated delivery Sep 22-23; 3-month Audible Premium Plus trial offer.

wikis.title: What Hi-Fi: Sony upgrades WH-CH730N and WH-CH530 budget headphones
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi news on Sony's WH-CH730N and WH-CH530, successors to the WH-CH720N and WH-CH520.
wikis.body:
- What Hi-Fi?, published 7 September 2026, by Harry McKerrell.
- WH-CH730N succeeds the WH-CH720N; WH-CH530 succeeds the WH-CH520.
- WH-CH730N has an external redesign (smoother, more premium, "not entirely dissimilar to the more expensive Sonos Ace") and folds away, unlike its predecessor. WH-CH530 design largely unchanged (small rounded on-ear cups).
- Hardware largely unchanged, same 30mm dynamic drivers; Sony claims a "major sonic boost" from improved DSP and algorithms, with DSEE on board.
- Battery: WH-CH730N 75 hours with noise cancelling off (vs 50 for WH-CH720N); WH-CH530 55 hours (up 5 from 50). Quick charge of WH-CH730N: three minutes gives around an hour of playback.

wikis.title: Sony WH-1000XM6 (Olive Gray) product page
wikis.summary: Sony Electronics store page for the WH-1000XM6 noise cancelling headphones.
wikis.body:
- Price $459.99; colors Black, Midnight Blue, Olive Gray, Platinum Silver, Sand Pink, Sandstone.
- HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3, "7x faster than the QN1", optimizing 12 microphones in real time; up to 30-hour battery, quick charging, multipoint, Sound Connect app.
- Claims "the best noise cancellation" as of June 1, 2026 (per Sony's own measurement research). Co-created with mastering audio engineers.
- Estimated delivery Sep 22-23; 3-month Audible Premium Plus trial.

wikis.title: Sony announces WH-1000XM6 in Olive Gray
wikis.summary: Sony UK press release of 3 August 2026 announcing the Olive Gray finish for the WH-1000XM6.
wikis.body:
- Sony UK press centre, 3 August 2026.
- New Olive Gray finish joins the Sand Pink and Sandstone additions, continuing "premium, nature-inspired finishes".
- Headphones otherwise continue to deliver "the best noise cancellation" (as of June 1, 2026, per Sony measurement against top 10 brands' headband wireless NC headphones).
- Available at sony.co.uk.

wikis.title: SoundGuys: Sony WH-1000XM6 now in Olive Gray
wikis.summary: SoundGuys news on Sony's new Olive Gray color for the WH-1000XM6.
wikis.body:
- SoundGuys, Aug 3, 2026, by Akshay Gangwar.
- Olive Gray is the third new XM6 color this year (Sandstone in May, Sand Pink in February), the sixth overall alongside Black, Silver, Midnight Blue.
- Headphones otherwise unchanged (10-band EQ, spatial audio, DSEE Extreme); SoundGuys measured 37 hours 14 minutes battery in its standardized test.
- Priced $459.99 at Sony's site and Amazon, the same as other colors; the listed MSRP in the widget is $449.99.

wikis.title: JBL Quantum 850 gaming headset
wikis.summary: JBL press release introducing the Quantum 850 wireless multiplatform gaming headset.
wikis.body:
- JBL news, Cologne, 26 August 2026.
- Hi-Res certified 50mm Carbon Dynamic Drivers; JBL Quantum Spatial Sound with Head Tracking (QuantumENGINE); Adaptive Noise Cancelling; new 6mm unidirectional/cardioid boom microphone.
- Dual wireless: low-latency 2.4GHz USB-C dongle and Bluetooth 5.3; also USB-C and 3.5mm wired.
- Air mesh hammock suspension, leatherette ear cushions; replaceable microphone, cable, cushions, earcaps, hammock and battery pack.
- QuantumENGINE features gaming EQ and AI keyboard noise reduction; compatible with Windows, macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Android, PlayStation, Nintendo; Zoom Certified.
- Sits beside the top-of-range JBL Quantum 950. Price EUR 279.99, available from August 2026.

wikis.title: JBL Quantum 850 and three mid-range headsets unveiled at Gamescom
wikis.summary: GamesRadar report that JBL unveiled the Quantum 850, 520, 520X and 120 gaming headsets at Gamescom.
wikis.body:
- Published 26 August 2026 (by Rosalie Newcombe). JBL again chose Gamescom to launch new Quantum headsets.
- **Quantum 850**: £249.99, multi-platform, "expected to launch on October 1 later this year". Hi-Res-certified 50mm Carbon Dynamic drivers, spatial sound and head tracking via JBL QuantumENGINE software (which was updated alongside last year's Gamescom). Replaceable system: microphone, USB-C cable, ear cushions, earcaps, hammock and battery pack. Adaptive Noise Cancelling; Bluetooth 5.2 plus low-latency 2.4 GHz wireless; USB-C and 3.5mm wired options.
- **Quantum 520, 520X, 120**: said to be available already from the JBL website (the writer could not yet find listings). Same 50mm carbon dynamic drivers and detachable 6mm cardioid boom mic. The 520 and 520X have dual wireless and up to 37 hours battery; the 120 is wired-only via 3.5mm.
- The Quantum 650, in the same lineup, is £99.99 at JBL with similar features.
- The writer questions why a brand would release so many headsets at once.

wikis.title: JBL Quantum 850 and new mid-range gaming headsets at Gamescom
wikis.summary: Trusted Reviews news on JBL's Quantum 850, 520, 520X and 120 headsets, with specs, battery life and pricing.
wikis.body:
- Published August 26, 2026 (Gian Estrada). The refresh adds the Quantum 850, 520, 520X and 120, joining the existing Quantum 650 Wireless.
- All five share 50 mm carbon dynamic drivers, Hi-Res Audio certification, Quantum Spatial Sound and JBL QuantumENGINE software.
- Quantum 850 is the premium model with Adaptive Noise Cancelling; compatible with iPad OS, PlayStation and Nintendo certified.
- Connectivity: 850, 650, 520 and 520X are dual wireless (2.4GHz dongle or Bluetooth); the 120 is wired 3.5mm and supports PlayStation, Xbox and other consoles. The 520X carries Xbox certification.
- Battery: Quantum 650 up to 45 hours; 520 and 520X up to 37 hours; each gains an extra hour from a five-minute charge.
- Silicone headband, breathable fabric ear cushions; colours from Black and Ice to Coral and Purple (520X Black only). Every model has a detachable noise-cancelling 6mm cardioid boom mic.
- Carsten Olesen, President of Consumer Audio at HARMAN, said the updates reflect JBL's strong entry into gaming audio.
- Pricing and dates: 520, 520X and 120 on sale from 26 August; 650 already available; prices span £39.99 (wired 120) to £129.99 (650). The 850 goes on sale 1st October for £249.99 / €279.99.

wikis.title: Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) product page
wikis.summary: Bose store page for the QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen), priced $359, with features and warranty options.
wikis.body:
- Listed as a "New product": Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen), price $359.00, customer rating 4.3 out of 5.
- Features listed: refreshed design, QuietControl noise cancellation, TrueSpatial Technology for immersive sound, plush comfort, clearer call quality, intuitive button placement, Bose app customisation, up to 24 hours battery (18 with Immersive Audio).
- Described as "the next evolution of the original noise cancelling headphones"; pill-shaped earcups, wider sliding headband; updated ActiveSense Technology adapts audio in Aware Mode; Immersive Audio gives a wider soundstage.
- Extras: BoseCare Accident Protection Plan (3-year, $59.95), BoseCare Protection Plan (2-year after the 1-year limited warranty, $49.95), Bose Gift Box $9.95; accessories AirFly Pro 2 $59.99, AirFly SE $34.99.
- Purchase terms: 30-day return policy, price match within 14 days, standard shipping free on orders of $49 or more, Klarna/Afterpay pay-in-4.

wikis.title: Bose announces QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen)
wikis.summary: Bose press release, August 6, 2026, announcing the QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) with TrueSpatial immersive audio, a new design and $359 price.
wikis.body:
- August 6, 2026: Bose announced the QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen). Preorder begins August 8 on Bose.com and select resellers for $359; shipping starts August 13.
- Colours: Black, White Smoke, and three limited editions: Eucalyptus Green, Dewdrop Mint, Rosewood Mauve.
- Bose TrueSpatial Technology adds three Immersive Audio modes previously exclusive to the QuietComfort Ultra series: Still, Motion, Cinema.
- Lossless playback over wired USB-C audio up to 24 bit/48 kHz; SoundDesign DSP retained.
- Noise cancellation now called QuietControl, with new adaptive feedforward controls and a six-microphone system that compensates for gaps in the earcup seal (helps glasses wearers); improved ActiveSense in Aware Mode; Custom Modes in the Bose app.
- Design: adjustable sliders, softer synthetic leather cushioning, oval earcups, hidden colour pops inside earcups.
- Controls: physical buttons; left earcup button for listening mode and voice assistant or Spotify Tap. Bluetooth Core 5.4 with multipoint (two devices), Google Fast Pair, two-way USB-C audio, USB-C to 3.5 mm cable included.

wikis.title: Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) announcement (SoundGuys)
wikis.summary: SoundGuys report on Bose's QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) with Immersive Audio, better ANC and lossless USB-C, at $359.
wikis.body:
- Aug 6, 2026 (Adamya Sharma). Successor, a little over two years after the original QuietComfort Headphones.
- Design: smoother adjustable headband, more synthetic-leather cushioning, optimized clamping force, hidden colour pops inside earcups. Colours: Black, White Smoke, limited-edition Eucalyptus Green, Dewdrop Mint, Rosewood Mauve.
- Audio: Bose TrueSpatial Immersive Audio (Still, Motion, Cinema) comes to the standard QuietComfort line for the first time, previously exclusive to QuietComfort Ultra; SoundDesign DSP; lossless wired USB-C up to 24-bit/48kHz.
- ANC: QuietControl with six-microphone array and adaptive feedforward controls; improved ActiveSense in Aware Mode.
- Bluetooth 5.4 with multipoint, Google Fast Pair, two-way USB-C audio, USB-C-to-3.5mm cable included.
- Battery up to 24 hours (18 with Immersive Audio); 15-minute quick charge gives up to 2.5 hours. App offers three-band EQ, custom modes, firmware updates.
- Preorder August 8 for $359; shipping August 13.

wikis.title: Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 announcement
wikis.summary: Sennheiser press release (August 20, 2026) introducing the MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 earbuds with replaceable batteries and Dolby Atmos head tracking, $299.95.
wikis.body:
- Hanover, Germany, August 20, 2026: Sennheiser announced MOMENTUM True Wireless 5, "its most advanced true wireless earbuds yet".
- Highlights: new design; user-replaceable batteries in earbuds and case (compact screwdriver); Dolby Atmos optimized head tracking; voice accelerometer, expanded mic array, AI speech enhancement; Bluetooth 6.0; Smart Control Plus app with 8-band EQ.
- Sound: 7mm TrueResponse dynamic transducer made in Tullamore, Ireland; aptX Adaptive up to 24-bit/96 kHz including aptX Lossless; Snapdragon Sound; low-latency gaming mode.
- ANC: adaptive hybrid ANC, automatic anti-wind mode, four-microphone array; eight sensors for voice (six mics, two bone-conduction accelerometers).
- Battery: 12 hours per charge, up to 40 total hours with the Qi-enabled case; 8-minute quick charge gives up to 1 hour.
- Fit: rated more comfortable than prior generation by 73% of testers; IP54.
- Five colourways (Graphite, Cream, Copper, Denim, Lavender); ships September 3 at MSRP $299.95 USD.
- Quotes from Frank Foppe (Product Manager) and Lilika Beck (President, Sennheiser Consumer Hearing).

wikis.title: Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 and ACCENTUM Clip (APAC release)
wikis.summary: Sonova Consumer Hearing press release, 21 Aug 2026, announcing the MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 and the open-ear ACCENTUM Clip earbuds.
wikis.body:
- News provided by Sonova Consumer Hearing, 21 Aug, 2026. Quote from Jake Chia, General Manager, Sonova Consumer Hearing Singapore.
- **MOMENTUM True Wireless 5**: flagship; user-replaceable batteries, Dolby Atmos optimized head tracking, Bluetooth 6.0, 7mm TrueResponse transducer, aptX Lossless, adaptive hybrid ANC, 12 hours per charge / up to 40 total hours, 8-minute charge for 1 hour. Colours: Graphite, Cream, Copper, Denim, Lavender. Preorder starts today; ships September 3 from sg.sennheiser-hearing.com and Sennheiser retailers.
- **ACCENTUM Clip**: open-ear clip-on earbuds, 12mm dynamic driver, Bluetooth 6.0 with multipoint and Google Fast Pair, LDAC on compatible devices, 6.8g each, IP54, 9 hours per charge and 36 hours total with case, 10-minute charge gives 2 hours, dual mics with AI noise reduction, Smart Control Plus 5-band EQ. Colours Black and Cream; zero-plastic packaging; available at sg.sennheiser-hearing.com and Sennheiser retailers.

wikis.title: Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5
wikis.summary: Flagship earbuds with replaceable batteries and Dolby Atmos head tracking.
wikis.body:
- User-replaceable batteries in earbuds and case; 12 hours per charge, up to 40 hours with case; 8-minute top-up gives up to 1 hour.
- Bluetooth 6.0, aptX Adaptive up to 24-bit/96 kHz, aptX Lossless; 7mm TrueResponse transducer.
- Adaptive hybrid ANC, four-microphone array, eight voice sensors.
- Five colours; ships September 3.

wikis.title: Sennheiser ACCENTUM Clip
wikis.summary: Open-ear clip-on earbuds weighing 6.8g each.
wikis.body:
- 12mm dynamic driver, Dynamic EQ, SBC/AAC and LDAC; Bluetooth 6.0.
- IP54; 9 hours per charge, 36 hours total; 10-minute charge gives 2 hours.
- AI-enhanced dual-mic system; Black and Cream.

wikis.title: Sonova announces Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 (audioXpress)
wikis.summary: audioXpress news, August 20 2026, on the Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 earbuds, with critical comment on the replaceable batteries.
wikis.body:
- August 20 2026 (Joao Martins). Sonova, "while attempting to offload its consumer division and its licensing agreement with Sennheiser", announced the earbuds as an update to the brand's flagship.
- New: Dolby Atmos optimized head tracking, more hi-res codec options (aptX Adaptive up to 24-bit/96kHz, aptX Lossless), user-replaceable batteries in earbuds and case, Bluetooth 6.0 (article says LE Audio and Auracast will be supported from launch).
- Design takes ideas from the Momentum 5 Wireless headphones launched in May 2026; rounder shape closer to Accentum earbuds; fin-less shape rated more comfortable by 73% of testers; IP54; narrower case.
- Adaptive hybrid ANC, anti-wind mode, four-microphone array; eight voice sensors; 7mm TrueResponse transducers; Smart Control Plus 8-band EQ.
- Battery: 12 hours per charge; 8-minute top-up gives up to 1 hour.
- The author is critical of replaceable batteries, saying the company does not say what users should do with replaced batteries.

wikis.title: Meze Audio ALBA in-ear monitors product page
wikis.summary: Meze Audio store page for the ALBA dynamic-driver in-ear monitors, $159, with specifications and reviews.
wikis.body:
- ALBA: in-ear monitors described as "a perfectly accessible and qualitative introduction to elevated audio enjoyment"; warm, balanced, musical sound.
- Single 10.8 mm dynamic driver; zinc alloy and anodized aluminum enclosure; detachable 2-pin (0.78 mm) cable with gold-plated 3.5 mm connector.
- Custom USB-C adapter with built-in DAC/AMP included (not included with ALBA S). Four pairs of silicone tips (S, M, L, XL) and an eco-leather pouch.
- Price: $159 (ALBA and ALBA S).
- Specs: sensitivity 109 dB SPL/mW at 1 kHz; frequency range 15 Hz - 25 kHz; THD <0.1% at 1 kHz; impedance 32 Ω; weight 14 g.
- 60 customer reviews shown, 77% (46) at the top rating tier; media review excerpts praise build, fit and included DAC adapter.

wikis.title: Nothing CMF Clip Pro product page
wikis.summary: Nothing US store page for the CMF Clip Pro open-ear earbuds at $99.
wikis.body:
- CMF Clip Pro, tagline "Clip on. Keep on.", open-ear earbuds for all-day comfort.
- Sections: design, controls, open-ear sound, Clear Voice Technology, battery, Nothing X app.
- Headline features: "Open-ear comfort, all day", "Hi-Res audio and LDAC", "Clear Voice Technology".
- Colours: Coral, Light Grey, Dark Grey. Price $99.

wikis.title: Nothing CMF Clip Pro earbuds launch (9to5Google)
wikis.summary: 9to5Google report that Nothing's CMF Clip Pro open-ear earbuds launched at $99 with a Smart Dial case.
wikis.body:
- Aug 4 2026 (Ben Schoon). Nothing's second pair of open-ear earbuds, under its CMF brand, available for $99, "$20 off during its initial launch window".
- Clip-style: attaches to the outside of the ear, unlike Nothing Ear (open) which hooks around the back.
- 10.8mm drivers in 5.92g earbuds, "Ultra Bass Technology" to offset open-ear bass loss.
- Battery: 10 hours on the earbuds, 32.5 hours with the case.
- CMF "Smart Dial" returns to control volume, playback and calls.
- Colours: Coral, Light Grey, Dark Grey.
- Pre-orders open at a discounted $79.99, standard $99.99 later in the month; Amazon pre-orders with an August 15 release date.

wikis.title: Nothing CMF Clip Pro earbuds with Smart Dial case (GSMArena)
wikis.summary: GSMArena news, 05 August 2026, on Nothing's CMF Clip Pro clip-on earbuds, specs and pricing.
wikis.body:
- 05 August 2026: Nothing unveiled the CMF Clip Pro, clip-on earbuds.
- 10.8mm drivers with "Ultra Bass Technology"; 10 hours of music and 6.5 hours of talk time per bud (60mAh each); case 475mAh; fast charge 10 minutes for four hours of playback.
- Bluetooth 5.4; LDAC, AAC, SBC; dual device connectivity; Google Fast Pair, Microsoft Swift Pair; low lag mode; four mics with Clear Voice Technology.
- IP54 buds, IPX2 case; buds 5.92g each, case 38.81g. Case Smart Dial controls volume, playback, calls and pairing; buds have tactile buttons.
- Available in US and UK on August 15 for $99 / £79; continental Europe and rest of world on September 15. Colours: Dark Grey, Light Grey, Coral. Pre-order at reduced $79 in the US.

wikis.title: SOUNDPEATS UU2 (POP Clip2) clip-on earbuds product page
wikis.summary: SOUNDPEATS store page for the UU2 (POP Clip2) open-ear clip-on earbuds, $49.99, with specs.
wikis.body:
- Price $49.99 (shown Out of Stock). UU2 and POP Clip2 are the same product; Bluetooth name and box say "POP Clip2".
- 12mm dual-magnet driver with DynamicEQ, up to 6.8 dB higher output than Clip1; two mics with AI noise reduction; Privacy Mode to limit leakage.
- Weight about 4.73-5g per earbud (TPU and nickel-titanium wire); redesigned U-Bridge; suits glasses wearers.
- Bluetooth 6.0, multipoint, SBC/AAC/LDAC, chipset BT8912F, 15-meter range.
- Battery: 10H per charge (7-8H with LDAC), 42H total with case; 10-minute charge gives 2H (page also says up to 3 hours); IPX5. Physical buttons.
- Box: earbuds, case, Type-C cable, manual, quick-start card, stickers. 1-year warranty.

wikis.title: SOUNDPEATS UU2 open-ear clip earbuds (The Gadgeteer)
wikis.summary: The Gadgeteer, August 17, 2026, on how the $49.99 SOUNDPEATS UU2 addresses open-ear bass and sound leakage, noting manufacturer claims.
wikis.body:
- August 17, 2026 (Rei Padla). Price $49.99, Amazon. Also called POP Clip2. SOUNDPEATS began its broader UU2 sales campaign on August 10, following an earlier launch in Japan.
- 12mm titanium-coated dual-magnet driver, DynamicEQ, Privacy Mode (reduces leakage, does not eliminate it; no ANC), physical buttons, Bluetooth 6.0, LDAC, Hi-Res Wireless certification.
- Each earbud about 5 grams with U-shaped bridge. Claims up to 6.8dB higher output than Clip1; article stresses these are "manufacturer claims".
- SOUNDPEATS says multipoint cannot be used while LDAC is enabled.
- Battery: up to 10 hours per charge, 42 hours with case; 10-minute quick charge claimed to give two hours (manufacturer-rated). IPX5, not for swimming or showering.

wikis.title: SOUNDPEATS UU2 (Pop Clip 2) open-ear earbuds under $50 (ecoustics)
wikis.summary: ecoustics article, updated August 10, 2026, on the $49.99 SOUNDPEATS UU2 with LDAC, Bluetooth 6.0, DynamicEQ and a 12mm titanium-coated driver.
wikis.body:
- Updated August 10, 2026 (Robert Silva). $49.99. UU2 and Pop Clip 2 are the same product. Follows the Pop Clip and Clip1 introduced in 2025.
- New 12mm titanium coated dual magnet dynamic driver with DynamicEQ; per SOUNDPEATS, up to +6.8 dB SPL over Clip1 and +3.2 dB SPL over Pop Clip.
- About 5 grams per earbud, updated U Bridge with skin friendly coating.
- Up to 10 hours per charge, up to 42 hours with case; quick charge of 10 minutes for further playback.
- Quote from founder Jason Yang: "Open ear listening should not require users to choose between comfort and musical impact".

wikis.title: FiiO CP11 ultra-thin Bluetooth cassette player (HiConsumption)
wikis.summary: HiConsumption, Aug 21 2026, on FiiO's CP11 portable cassette player added to its roadmap after CP15 delays, targeting late 2026.
wikis.body:
- Published Aug 21, 2026 (Ryan Calder). FiiO's CP13 kicked off the modern cassette revival in 2024; a slimmer CP15 was promised but did not come "to fruition"; the CP11 is a new player.
- Per FiiO, the CP15's ultra-thin mechanism proved difficult (structure, servo tuning, system coordination), so FiiO reshuffled its roadmap at the start of 2026 and slotted in the CP11.
- CP11 (F3283C): portable stereo cassette player; all-new ultra-thin mechanism, upgraded magnetic head, brushless motor with new servo drive, revised circuitry; Bluetooth transmission (which CP13 lacked), 3.5mm output; USB-C charging (5V/2A). Colours shown: cream, green, silver; a battery hatch on the back.
- Software and PCBA work nearly done; mechanism trial production next. CP15 not dead; internals basically complete, FiiO hopes to ship within half a year.
- No pricing announced; expected launch late 2026 and FiiO admits timing could slip. CP13 currently runs about $99 to $110.

wikis.title: FiiO CP11 cassette player added to roadmap (StereoNET)
wikis.summary: StereoNET, 25th August 2026, reports FiiO's Bluetooth CP11 cassette player added after the CP15 proved harder to develop.
wikis.body:
- 25th August, 2026 (Jason Sexton). FiiO added the CP11 to its roadmap after development of the more ambitious CP15 proved "considerably more difficult than expected"; it reorganised plans at the beginning of 2026.
- Challenges with the all-new ultra-thin mechanism: physical structure, servo system, overall integration. CP15 remains under development, not cancelled.
- CP11: all-new ultra-thin mechanism, higher-quality magnetic head, brushless motor, new servo drive, redesigned circuitry; Bluetooth transmission (the CP13 had no Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or DAC); physical controls along the top; slimmer, softer-edged than the CP13; finishes shown include red, cream and light blue.
- FiiO says it spent around two years on the new cassette platform and that the supply chain for such mechanisms is extremely limited.
- Software and circuit-board work almost complete; mechanism trial production next. Aim: out before end of 2026, timing could slip. CP15 software and PCBA reportedly largely complete; could follow in around six months.
- Pricing and regional availability not announced.

wikis.title: FiiO SNOWSKY Echo Nano retro HiFi music player (Amazon listing)
wikis.summary: Amazon US listing for the FiiO SNOWSKY Echo Nano retro music player with scroll wheel and CS43131 DAC, $49.99.
wikis.body:
- Listing price $49.99 (black), sold by SNOWSKY, ships from Amazon Fulfillment.
- Retro design with tactile scroll wheel and physical controls; CS43131 DAC; 3.5mm output.
- Supports DSD256, FLAC, WAV, APE, MP3, AAC; microSD expansion up to 256GB.
- Can act as a USB DAC for a computer; CNC-machined aluminum alloy body; protective clip.
- Listing bundles suggestion with WIND PRO in-line-control earphones mention.

wikis.title: FiiO Snowsky Echo Nano launches in US (Notebookcheck)
wikis.summary: Notebookcheck, 07/27/2026, on the $49.99 Snowsky Echo Nano MP3 player modelled on the 2006 Sony Network Walkman.
wikis.body:
- Published 07/27/2026 (David Chien). Available on Amazon for $49.99 in Green, Pink, Sky Blue and White.
- Styled after the 2006 Sony Network Walkman NW-S600/S700F series; 83.5 x 23 x 14 mm, 33.5 g, CNC-machined aluminum-magnesium alloy, protected metal control knob, 3.5 mm jack, 0.91-inch multi-line OLED display.
- microSD up to 256 GB; supports MP3, M4A, OGG, DSD256, and 192 kHz 24-bit WAV, FLAC, APE.
- 360 mAh battery, up to 7 hours playback per Fiio.
- Cirrus Logic CS43131 DAC, Sony Hi-Res Audio certified; 32 mW per channel at 32 ohms, THD under 0.0003%, SNR over 129 dB. Works as USB external sound card (UAC).

wikis.title: FIIO NATURE wired over-ear headphones (AliExpress listing)
wikis.summary: AliExpress US listing for the FIIO NATURE wired over-ear headphones with 50mm dynamic driver, about $43.35.
wikis.body:
- FIIO NATURE Wired Over-Ear Headphones, 50mm dynamic driver, 3.5mm with mic, lightweight.
- Price $43.35 (was $50.35); rating 4.9 from 30 reviews, 136 sold. Colours include Black and Apricot.
- Review tags mention well-balanced sound, excellent value, clarity focused sound, good bass, lightweight design, and "fatiguing treble".

wikis.title: FiiO Snowsky Nature over-ear headphones (Notebookcheck)
wikis.summary: Notebookcheck, 07/22/2026, on the Snowsky Nature wired headphones with carbon black diaphragms and faux wood grain, under $50.
wikis.body:
- Published 07/22/2026 (David Chien). Over-ear, Hi-Res Audio oriented, black or apricot; MSRP $49.03 on AliExpress.
- 280 g; 50 mm Japanese carbon black diaphragms; 20 Hz to 40 kHz; 24 ohms; 101 dB/mW.
- Wood-grain pattern via water-transfer printing; earpads twist off; self-adjusting padded headband.
- Detachable 1.5 m 3.5 mm unbalanced cable with remote and mic; also works with the Fiio LL-4.4A balanced cable.

wikis.title: Snowsky by FiiO Nature headphones (The Audiophile Man)
wikis.summary: Short news item, 19th August 2026, announcing the Snowsky by FiiO Nature wired over-ear headphones at $38.99.
wikis.body:
- 19th August 2026. Snowsky by FiiO announced the Nature over-ear wired headphones.
- Newly engineered 50mm dynamic drivers; the larger diaphragm "reportedly" moves more air while keeping precision. New Japanese carbon black diaphragm: 19-micron PET structural layer plus 30-micron TPU damping layer.
- Cable ends in 3.5mm TRS and has a microphone. Weight 280g.
- Price: $38.99, €38.99 or £38.99.

wikis.title: Astell & Kern PD5 digital audio player (What Hi-Fi?)
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi? news, 4 August 2026, on the Astell & Kern PD5 player with eight DACs and 28-hour battery life; price and release date unconfirmed.
wikis.body:
- Published 4 August 2026 (Joe Svetlik). PD5 follows the Award-winning A&norma SR35 with eight extra hours of battery and twice the DACs.
- Switchable between four and eight Cirrus Logic CS43198 DACs (SR35: two or four); all eight for full sound quality, four to extend battery.
- Battery: total 28 hours quoted (not stated with eight DACs); about 2.5 hours to full via PD 3.0 charging.
- New EnviroTune analyses ambient noise and optimises sound.
- Up to 32-bit/384kHz PCM and native DSD256; octa-core processor, Android-based; streaming services not confirmed (writer assumes Tidal, Qobuz, Amazon Music, Apple Music).
- Dual-band wi-fi, Bluetooth 5.3, aptX HD, LDAC, LHDC.
- "A lot of details are still to be confirmed, including its price and release date"; SR35 launched at £799 / $799 / AU$1299. On show at Hong Kong AV show, Shenzhen International Audio Show (SIAS) 14th-16th August, and CanJam SoCal 2026, August 29th-30th.

wikis.title: Marantz MCR 60n compact all-in-one hi-fi system product page
wikis.summary: Marantz US product page for the MCR 60n all-in-one system with CD player, HEOS streaming, HDMI eARC and MM phono, $1,000.
wikis.body:
- Price $1,000; listed Out of Stock (Black), notify-me option.
- Compact all-in-one system: 65W + 65W into 4 ohms, built-in CD player, MM phono input, HEOS multi-room streaming, Bluetooth, HDMI eARC, subwoofer support, Roon Ready, PCM up to 384kHz/32-bit.
- Upgraded DAC, tuned by the Sound Master. Services: TIDAL, Pandora, Amazon Music HD, Spotify, Deezer, Sirius XM, AirPlay, Alexa.
- Spec table: CD/CD-R/RW/WMA/MP3 playback; tuner FM/AM (no DAB/DAB+).
- Comparison lists SACD 30n ($3,500), MODEL 60n ($1,600), CD 70 ($750).
- Free delivery, 30-day returns, price match.

wikis.title: Marantz introduces the MCR 60n compact all-in-one system
wikis.summary: The Absolute Sound news, Sep 10, 2026, on Marantz's MCR 60n / MCR 60n DAB all-in-one system, available from September 15th 2026.
wikis.body:
- Dated "September 9th, 2026" (posted Sep 10, 2026, TAS Staff): Marantz introduces the MCR 60n (North America) and MCR 60n DAB (Europe only), "the most capable compact music system Marantz has ever created".
- Combines CD playback, network streaming, HDMI eARC, turntable connection (new MM phono stage) and amplification. Finishes: Matte Black and Marantz Champagne Gold (not in North America).
- New power supply; 65 watts per channel into 4 ohms; four amplifier channels with Bi-Amp, Parallel BTL and dual speaker outputs.
- HDMI eARC with HDMI-CEC volume control and Dolby Digital / Digital Plus decoding. Streaming: PCM up to 384kHz/32-bit, DSD up to 11.2MHz, latest HEOS; Spotify, TIDAL, Qobuz Connect, AirPlay 2, Roon Ready; four Smart Select presets.
- Bluetooth receive and transmit; configurable subwoofer output; Dirac Live Room Correction as an optional upgrade; variable outputs allow use as streaming preamp; Ethernet, USB, optical input, DAB tuner (Europe only).
- Available from authorized retailers and Marantz.com from September 15th 2026.

wikis.title: Rotel Michi Prestige S430 stereo power amplifier product page
wikis.summary: Rotel product page for the Michi Prestige S430 Class AB stereo power amplifier rated 390W per channel into 4 ohms.
wikis.body:
- Michi Prestige S430 Stereo Power Amplifier: Class AB, 2 x 390 Watts into 4 ohms; 230 W/Ch (8 ohms, non-FTC continuous), 250 W/Ch FTC (8 ohms).
- Oversized in-house toroidal transformer, bulk storage capacitors, balanced XLR and RCA inputs, dual 5-way binding posts, front-panel display with selectable meter views, remote included.
- Specs: THD < 0.03%; frequency response 10 Hz - 100 kHz (0±0.4 dB); S/N > 115 dB; damping factor 350; 4 ohm minimum; power consumption 550 W; 431 x 148 x 405 mm; 17.5 kg (38.6 lbs).

wikis.title: Michi Prestige P430 pre-amplifier and S430 power amplifier (Hifi Pig)
wikis.summary: Hifi Pig, September 2, 2026, on Rotel Michi's new P430 pre-amp and S430 power amp, each $3,999, available from September 2026.
wikis.body:
- September 2, 2026: Rotel Michi expanded the Prestige Series with the P430 Pre-amplifier and S430 Stereo Power Amplifier, joining the X430 Integrated Amplifier and Q430 CD Player.
- P430: ESS SABRE ES9028PRO 8-channel DAC; balanced XLR and RCA outputs; dual mono subwoofer outputs; 6.35mm headphone output; sources include turntables, streaming, Bluetooth and TV audio.
- S430: 230 W/ch into 8 ohms, 390 W/ch into 4 ohms; toroidal transformer, bulk-storage capacitors, XLR and RCA inputs, gold-plated 5-way terminals; TFT display with VU and spectrum meter views.
- Available from September 2026; each priced $3,999, €3,999 or £3,599.

wikis.title: Rotel Michi Prestige P430 stereo pre-amplifier product page
wikis.summary: Rotel's product page for the Michi Prestige P430 stereo preamplifier with its features and specifications.
wikis.body:
- Michi Prestige P430 pre-amplifier: brings TV audio, vinyl, computer audio, Bluetooth and premium source components together; integrated 32-bit DAC, ultra-low-noise power supply.
- ESS SABRE ES9028PRO 8-channel 32-bit DAC with advanced clocking.
- Balanced XLR inputs and outputs; moving-magnet phono input; Certified Roon Tested; Bluetooth with aptX HD and AAC.
- Connectivity: XLR and RCA analogue in/out, coaxial and optical digital inputs, HDMI ARC (CEC; 2-channel PCM only up to 24-bit/48 kHz), PC-USB (USB Audio Class 2, up to 32-bit/384 kHz, driver required; DSD up to 4x/11.2 MHz, DoP up to 2x).
- Specs: THD < 0.002%; line-level frequency response 10 Hz-100 kHz, 0 +/-0.3 dB; S/N (A-weighted) 110 dB RCA, 106 dB XLR, 103 dB digital, 82 dB phono; tone controls +/-10 dB at 100 Hz/10 kHz; output 1 V RCA, 2 V XLR.
- Size 431 x 148 x 404 mm; 10.8 kg (23.8 lbs); 120 V, 60 Hz; 45 W consumption; standby < 0.5 W (network wakeup < 2 W).

wikis.title: Rotel adds Michi Prestige P430 preamp and S430 stereo amp
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi? news that Rotel's Michi range gains the Prestige P430 preamplifier and S430 stereo power amplifier, available September with $3,999 pricing.
wikis.body:
- Published 2 September 2026 by Harry McKerrell.
- Two new Michi Prestige models: P430 preamplifier and S430 stereo amplifier.
- S430: aimed at listeners stepping up to separates; 230 watts per channel into 8 ohms; oversized in-house toroidal transformer, large bulk-storage capacitors, isolated signal routing, multi-stage push-pull output transistors ("firm bass control", "dynamic impact"); balanced XLR and RCA inputs, dual 5-way speaker binding posts; aluminium chassis, front display with selectable meters and backlit power toggle.
- P430: ESS SABRE ES9028PRO 8-channel DAC; PCM up to 32-bit/384kHz and DSD256; balanced XLR and RCA inputs/outputs, coaxial and optical inputs, HDMI ARC, moving magnet phono stage, dual subwoofer outputs, 6.35mm headphone port, Bluetooth with aptX HD (files up to 24-bit/48kHz).
- Availability: this September. Price: S430 and P430 each GBP 3599 / $3999 / EUR 3999.

wikis.title: Michi Prestige P430 pre-amplifier and S430 power amplifier press release
wikis.summary: Michi's 1 September 2026 announcement of the P430 pre-amp and S430 stereo power amp joining the Prestige Series, available from September 2026.
wikis.body:
- Tokyo, Japan (September 1, 2026). The P430 and S430 join the existing X430 Integrated Amplifier and Q430 CD Player in the Michi Prestige Series, offering a dedicated pre/power solution.
- P430: ESS SABRE ES9028PRO 8-channel DAC; three coaxial and three optical digital inputs, PC-USB with DSD256, Roon Tested, Bluetooth aptX HD/AAC, HDMI ARC; analogue inputs one balanced XLR, three RCA line, MM phono; dual balanced XLR, dual RCA and a line-level output (usable in pre/power or bi-amp systems); coaxial and optical digital outputs; dual mono subwoofer outputs.
- S430: 390 watts per channel into 4 ohms (230 W into 8 ohms); oversized in-house toroidal transformer; balanced XLR and RCA inputs, 5-way speaker terminals, 12V trigger, auto power-off; front-panel TFT display with selectable VU and spectrum meter views.
- Availability: from September 2026. Suggested retail for each: $3,999 / EUR 3,999 / GBP 3,599.
- Michi describes itself as built on "more than 60 years of engineering heritage".

wikis.title: Yamaha WXA-70A compact streaming amplifier product page
wikis.summary: Yamaha USA product page for the WXA-70A compact wireless streaming amplifier and its features.
wikis.body:
- WXA-70A Compact Streaming Amplifier, marked "New"; controlled via the MusicCast app.
- Streaming: Wi-Fi with AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, TIDAL Connect, Qobuz Connect, Roon Ready; MusicCast multi-room.
- Inputs: HDMI eARC/ARC for TV (TV remote power/volume control), turntable and CD player inputs.
- DAC: ESS SABRE ES9039Q2M, with Yamaha's proprietary "DAC on Pure Ground" configuration.
- YPAO room calibration with included microphone and YPAO R.S.C. (Reflected Sound Control).
- Rigid aluminum enclosure, gold-plated speaker terminals, front-panel OLED display, included remote, adjustable Dialogue Level control.
- Integration: Control4 compatibility, web setup, IR input, 12V trigger; Wi-Fi and Bluetooth can be independently disabled during installation.
- Related product: WXC-70A compact streamer.

wikis.title: Yamaha WXC-70A compact streamer product page
wikis.summary: Yamaha USA product page for the WXC-70A compact wireless music streamer that adds streaming to an existing integrated amplifier or receiver.
wikis.body:
- WXC-70A Compact Streamer, marked "New"; adds wireless streaming to an existing integrated amplifier or receiver; controlled via the MusicCast app.
- Streaming: Wi-Fi with AirPlay, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, TIDAL Connect, Qobuz Connect, Roon Ready and more; MusicCast multi-room.
- HDMI eARC for TV sound, inputs for a turntable and CD player; analog and digital outputs with player and preamplifier modes.
- "DAC on Pure Ground" configuration; YPAO room calibration with included microphone and YPAO R.S.C.
- Rigid aluminum enclosure.
- Integration: Control4 compatibility, web setup, IR input, 12V trigger.

wikis.title: Yamaha WXA-70A and WXC-70A compact streaming components announced
wikis.summary: TWICE report of Yamaha's new WXA-70A streaming amplifier ($1,299.95) and WXC-70A streamer/preamp ($999.95), available in November 2026.
wikis.body:
- Published September 3, 2026 (TWICE Staff).
- WXA-70A Compact Streaming Amplifier: turns passive speakers into a complete Hi-Fi system, or extends a Yamaha AVENTAGE home theater system to other rooms.
- WXC-70A Compact Streamer (Preamplifier): adds streaming to existing systems, pairing with Yamaha A-S Series integrated amplifiers.
- Both: AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, TIDAL Connect, Qobuz Connect, Roon Ready; MusicCast; HDMI eARC with TV-remote power/volume control; analog and digital inputs (turntable needs a compatible phono preamp); YPAO calibration microphone and YPAO R.S.C.; Control4 compatibility, web setup, IR input, 12V trigger.
- Quote from Alex Sadeghian, director of marketing, consumer audio at Yamaha: made "for music lovers who want to enjoy exceptional sound combined with simple operation and ease of use".
- Pricing: WXA-70A $1,299.95 MSRP; WXC-70A $999.95 MSRP; available in November 2026.

wikis.title: Yamaha WXA-70A and WXC-70A announced ahead of CEDIA 2026
wikis.summary: ecoustics article on Yamaha's new compact streaming amp and streamer, compared with the 2016 WXA-50 and WXC-50.
wikis.body:
- Updated August 27, 2026 (Robert Silva). Framed as Yamaha's return after a decade: the WXA-50 and WXC-50 launched in 2016.
- WXA-70A Compact Streaming Amplifier and WXC-70A Compact Streamer (Preamplifier); audiophile-grade ESS SABRE ES9039Q2M DAC in both.
- Streaming: AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, TIDAL Connect, Qobuz Connect, Roon Ready; MusicCast; HDMI eARC; YPAO with mic; Control4, web setup, IR input, 12V trigger.
- Difference: WXA-70A has a built-in two-channel amplifier to power passive speakers; WXC-70A has none, but can feed self-powered speakers from its preamp outputs or add streaming to older systems. Both have a subwoofer output. A turntable needs an external phono preamp.
- Comparison table: MSRP WXA-70A $1,299.95 vs WXA-50 $599.95; WXC-70A $999.95 vs WXC-50 $449.95. WXA-70A 55 W + 55 W (8 ohms), 70 W + 70 W (6 ohms) at 0.06% THD. WXA-70A 5.7 lbs, 8 5/8" x 2 7/8" x 10 1/2"; WXC-70A 4.2 lbs; black or silver finishes.
- Bottom line: the writer says ten years is "an eternity in network audio" and names WiiM, Bluesound and Marantz as competitors.

wikis.title: Naim Uniti Star Lite streaming amplifier product page
wikis.summary: Naim Audio's product page for the Uniti Star Lite all-in-one streaming amplifier, successor to the Uniti Star.
wikis.body:
- Uniti Star Lite: "the natural evolution of the Uniti Star all-in-one player"; streaming amplifier with Spotify, TIDAL, Qobuz, internet radio; connects to TV or games console.
- Amplifier: 70W per channel into 8 ohm, class AB.
- Inputs: 1 RCA and 1 5-pin DIN analogue; 2 optical (up to 24bit/96kHz), coaxial RCA and BNC (up to 24bit/192kHz, DoP 64Fs); 2 USB-A (front and rear). Outputs: stereo power amp, RCA pair, 3.5mm headphone.
- Formats: WAV up to 32bit/384kHz; FLAC, AIFF, ALAC up to 24bit/384kHz; DSD 64 and 128Fs; gapless on all.
- Streaming: AirPlay 2, Bluetooth, Chromecast, Qobuz Connect, Roon Ready, Spotify Connect, TIDAL Connect, UPnP; Ethernet and Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n/ac); multiroom incl. Party Mode syncing up to six Naim streamers; up to 20,000 tracks from USB storage (SSD max 1TB, stick max 128GB).
- Control: Focal & Naim app; Google Assistant and Siri; Control4, Crestron, Elan, RTI, Savant drivers; high-definition colour display.

wikis.title: Naim Uniti Star Lite launches without the CD player
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi? news that Naim's Uniti Star Lite keeps the original Star's streaming and 70W amp but drops the CD player and ripper due to a drive supply problem.
wikis.body:
- Published 28 August 2026 (Kashfia Kabir).
- Same streaming features, connections, hi-res specs and design as the original Uniti Star reviewed in 2018, minus the integrated CD player and ripper, hence "Lite".
- Reason: Naim's Richard Dane said it "run into difficulty in sourcing the CD drives"; the mechanism "suddenly ceased production"; Naim will stop the original Star and keep remaining CD mechanisms for repairs.
- Sits between Uniti Atom (GBP 2299 / $3799) and Uniti Nova (GBP 4399 / $6899).
- 70W per channel into 8 ohms, Class A/B; AirPlay 2, Google Cast, internet radio, Tidal/Qobuz/Spotify Connect, UPnP; Bluetooth updated to aptX Adaptive; Ethernet and dual-band wi-fi; Focal & Naim app (up to six compatible products).
- Inputs: RCA and 5-pin DIN analogue; optical, coaxial RCA, coaxial BNC; HDMI ARC; two USB-A; 3.5mm headphone. PCM up to 32-bit/384kHz and DSD128 via USB; 24-bit/192kHz on most other inputs.
- 5-inch display and illuminated dial; same dimensions but 1kg lighter without the CD drive. Naim confirmed sound quality improvements.

wikis.title: Naim unveils Uniti Star Lite all-in-one streaming system
wikis.summary: hi-fi+ news item on Naim's Uniti Star Lite, available only in the UK and Europe at GBP 3,199 / EUR 3,999.
wikis.body:
- Dated 27 August 2026.
- Described as a natural evolution of the Uniti range with a "more focused approach", drawing on "more than 50 years" of Naim expertise.
- Access to Spotify, Qobuz, TIDAL, internet radio and personal music libraries; TV audio and gaming.
- Controlled via the Focal & Naim app; compatible with Focal & Naim multiroom, Google Assistant and Apple Siri.
- Available exclusively in the UK and Europe. Recommended retail price: GBP 3,199 / EUR 3,999.

wikis.title: McIntosh CS7500 streaming preamplifier introduced
wikis.summary: McIntosh's 26 August 2026 news post introducing the CS7500 streaming preamplifier with phono, digital inputs, HDMI ARC and streaming.
wikis.body:
- Dated 08.26.2026.
- Combines McIntosh preamplification with a network streamer; power amplifier stays separate.
- Six analog inputs including a dedicated phono input; seven digital inputs.
- Quad Balanced, 8-channel, 32-bit DAC.
- Streaming: Qobuz, Spotify, TIDAL, Apple AirPlay, Google Cast, Bluetooth, Roon.
- HDMI ARC, converting Dolby and DTS multichannel formats for two-channel playback.
- Design: black glass front panel, illuminated logo, rotary knobs, blue meters; mirror-polished stainless steel lower chassis, hairline-brushed black titanium stainless steel upper chassis, custom-machined brushed end caps.
- McIntosh cites "more than 75 years". No price or date given in the text.

wikis.title: McIntosh announces CS7500 streaming preamplifier
wikis.summary: The Absolute Sound's 26 August 2026 report of McIntosh's CS7500 streaming preamplifier with its streaming support and inputs.
wikis.body:
- Binghamton, NY, August 26, 2026: McIntosh announced the CS7500 Streaming Preamplifier, combining a dedicated preamplifier and network streamer.
- Streaming: Qobuz Connect, Spotify Connect (including Spotify Lossless), TIDAL Connect (including TIDAL Max); Apple AirPlay, Bluetooth (AAC, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive), Google Cast; Roon Ready and Roon Tested.
- Inputs: six analog (two balanced, three unbalanced, one phono) and seven digital; USB supports native DSD512 and DXD up to 384kHz; coaxial and optical up to 24-bit/192kHz.
- Quad Balanced, 8-channel, 32-bit DAC; HDMI ARC input for TV audio.
- The power amplifier is chosen separately. No price in the extracted text.

wikis.title: McIntosh CS7500 streaming preamp details and price
wikis.summary: StereoNET's 27 August 2026 news article on the McIntosh CS7500, priced US$12,500 and available from 28th August.
wikis.body:
- Published 27th August, 2026 (Jay Garrett).
- Two-channel streaming preamplifier; Qobuz Connect, Spotify Connect (incl. Spotify Lossless), TIDAL Connect (incl. TIDAL Max); AirPlay, Bluetooth (AAC, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive), Google Cast; Roon Ready and Roon Tested.
- Six analogue inputs (two balanced, three unbalanced, phono for MC or MM with 40/46/52/58/64dB gain) and seven digital; USB native DSD512 and DXD up to 384kHz; coaxial/optical up to 24-bit/192kHz; Quad Balanced eight-channel 32-bit DAC; HDMI ARC with Dolby/DTS converted to two-channel.
- Outputs: two pairs of balanced and unbalanced variable outputs plus a fixed unbalanced output; second variable set assignable to subwoofer.
- Quoted specs: THD 0.005%; high-level S/N 100dB; phono S/N 80dB MC, 82dB MM; sensitivity 900mV balanced, 450mV unbalanced; max output 16V RMS balanced, 8V RMS unbalanced; response +0/-0.5dB 20Hz-20kHz.
- Controls: bass/treble, tone bypass, RS232, IR input, four data ports, power control outputs.
- Price: US$12,500 | CA$17,750 | GBP 14,000; available from 28th August.

wikis.title: Eversolo DMP-A8 Gen 2 series debuts at High End Vienna 2026
wikis.summary: ecoustics report on Eversolo's DMP-A8 Gen 2 and Master Edition Gen 2 streamer/DAC/preamps with AKM DAC, SFP fiber and Wi-Fi 6.
wikis.body:
- Updated June 4, 2026 (Ian White); debuted on the opening morning of High End Vienna 2026.
- Two versions: DMP-A8 Gen 2 (388 x 265 x 88 mm) and DMP-A8 Master Edition Gen 2 (388 x 265 x 98.5 mm). Master adds enhanced OCXO clocking with PLL, external clock input, and an in-house CD playback and ripping system.
- 8.6-inch LCD touchscreen; VU meters, spectrum, album art.
- DAC: AKM AK4191EQ digital processor + AK4499EX DAC; fully balanced analog preamp with R-2R volume control; THD+N as low as 0.000075%, SNR and DNR up to 129 dB.
- Playback: native stereo DSD512 and PCM up to 768kHz/32-bit (USB-B, USB out, I2S out); optical/coaxial up to 192kHz/24-bit and DoP64; HDMI ARC stereo PCM up to 192kHz/24-bit.
- 64-bit octa-core processor, 8GB DDR4, 64GB eMMC; scans up to 200,000 tracks in approximately two hours (Eversolo's claim); M.2 NVMe SSD slot up to 8TB (SSD not included).
- Streaming: TIDAL, Qobuz, HIGHRESAUDIO, Amazon Music, IDAGIO, Apple Music and more; TIDAL Connect, Qobuz Connect, Spotify Connect Lossless, DLNA.
- Connections: XLR/RCA in and out, optical, coaxial, USB, AES, I2S, HDMI ARC; subwoofer output with 40Hz-500Hz crossover; SFP fiber networking (Gigabit single-mode; module not included); dual-band Wi-Fi 6 and Ethernet.
- Pricing not in the extracted text.

wikis.title: DALI BASIK SUB compact active subwoofer announced
wikis.summary: Hifi Pig's 1 September 2026 announcement of the DALI BASIK SUB 8-inch active subwoofer, priced EUR 500 / $800 / GBP 429 for October.
wikis.body:
- September 1, 2026. Compact active subwoofer for music and home cinema; partner for DALI KUPID and SONIK 1 bookshelf speakers, for 2.1 systems.
- 8-inch in-house long-stroke down-firing woofer with paper-pulp diaphragm; four decoupled feet raise cabinet 25 mm.
- Class-D amplifier 170W RMS / 220W peak; bass reflex MDF cabinet 319 x 295 x 310 mm (H x W x D), 9.75 kg; ON/AUTO/OFF modes, auto standby after about 20 minutes, 0.4W standby.
- Volume, crossover 40-120Hz, phase 0-180 degrees; stereo LINE L/R and mono LFE inputs.
- Colours: Solid Black, Solid White, Caramel White, Golden Yellow, Chilly Blue.
- Scheduled for release in October; price EUR 500, $800, GBP 429.

wikis.title: Sonos Beam Ultra soundbar product page
wikis.summary: Sonos shop page for the Beam Ultra, a $699 compact soundbar with true 7.1.2 Dolby Atmos, on preorder.
wikis.body:
- Sonos Beam Ultra, $699, "Preorder".
- True Dolby Atmos 7.1.2 surround; design "nearly the same size as Beam".
- Hardware: nine Class-D amplifiers; five tweeters (forward-firing centre, two side-firing horn-loaded, two upward-firing); four low-profile woofers; far-field microphone array.
- Features: AI Speech Enhancement (four levels in the Sonos app), Night Sound, Trueplay room tuning, adjustable EQ, works with TV remote, HDMI eARC, WiFi, Bluetooth, Apple AirPlay 2, voice control, touch controls.
- Expandable with a Sub and rear surrounds, which can be a pair of Sonos Play or Move 2 speakers; can send TV audio to Sonos headphones.
- Box: soundbar, power cable, HDMI cable, guide. Wall mount sold separately.

wikis.title: Sonos introduces Beam Ultra and Sonos Ace Ultra
wikis.summary: Sonos press release of 1 September 2026 announcing the Beam Ultra soundbar ($699), Ace Ultra headphones ($449) and Sonos 27, with availability September 29, 2026.
wikis.body:
- Santa Barbara, Calif., Sept. 1, 2026: Sonos introduced Beam Ultra and Sonos Ace Ultra alongside the updated audio OS release Sonos 27.
- Beam Ultra: mid-size soundbar, nine custom drivers including two up-firing for true 7.1.2 Dolby Atmos; redesigned centre channel; four levels of AI Speech Enhancement; Night Sound; can add a Sub or rear surrounds, now including compatible Sonos portable speakers. Connects over WiFi, Bluetooth, HDMI eARC. Trueplay tuning.
- Sonos Ace Ultra: premium over-ear headphone; Sonos-designed 40mm driver; Adaptive ANC with ten microphones; up to 35 hours battery with ANC on; first headphone on Headphone Engine 2, which links directly into the Sonos system (available in Early Access); USB-C and 3.5mm; TrueCinema.
- Quotes from CEO Tom Conrad and Chris Jenkins, EVP Digital Studios, Universal Music Group.
- Pre-order from September 1, 2026 at $699 (Beam Ultra) and $449 (Ace Ultra); general availability September 29, 2026.
- Sonos says it serves "more than 17 million households in over 60 countries".

wikis.title: Engadget: Sonos unveils Beam Ultra soundbar
wikis.summary: Engadget's 1 September 2026 report on the $699 Sonos Beam Ultra with nine drivers and true 7.1.2 Dolby Atmos, available September 29.
wikis.body:
- Sept. 1, 2026 (Anna Washenko).
- Premium take on the mid-size soundbar; pre-orders begin today, available beginning September 29, suggested retail $699.
- Driver count rises from five to nine: five tweeters (one centre, two side-firing, two upward-firing) and four low-profile woofers. Upward-firing drivers mean it is no longer mimicking Dolby Atmos in software like the Beam.
- The writer notes that bouncing audio off the ceiling is "unlikely to match" standalone ceiling-mounted speakers.
- Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, HDMI eARC; AI Speech Enhancement with four levels in the Sonos app; portable speakers can act as rear surrounds.
- Sonos also introduced the Sonos Ace Ultra over-ear headphones and a big software update.

wikis.title: Sonos Ace Ultra headphones product page
wikis.summary: Sonos shop page for the $449 Ace Ultra noise-canceling headphones on preorder, with a direct link into the Sonos system.
wikis.body:
- Sonos Ace Ultra, $449, "Preorder".
- Custom 40mm driver per ear cup, tuned with GRAMMY and Oscar-winning engineers; ten microphones for noise control, calls, Aware mode and TrueCinema.
- Adaptive ANC ("up to 2x more" than Sonos Ace); Aware mode with voice boost; sidetone for calls.
- Up to 35 hours battery with ANC on; three minutes of charging gives up to three hours of playback.
- Lossless audio over Bluetooth with Qualcomm aptX (supported device) or USB-C; spatial audio, Dolby Atmos (needs compatible content/device), dynamic head tracking; USB-C and 3.5 mm.
- Headphone linking to the Sonos system via the Content Key, in Early Access (opt-in, as-is, subject to change); send soundbar TV audio to the headphones.
- 3-band or 8-band EQ, wear detection; ear cushions and battery replaceable.
- Box: headphones, travel case, USB-C to USB-C cable, USB-C to 3.5 mm cable.

wikis.title: Sonos Play portable speaker product page
wikis.summary: Sonos shop page for the $299 Sonos Play, a waterproof portable Bluetooth/WiFi speaker with 24-hour battery.
wikis.body:
- Sonos Play, $299, rated 4.9 / 5.
- Portable stereo speaker; 24 hour battery life; waterproof (IP67); drop resistant; WiFi and Bluetooth; charging base included (needs a USB-C/PD adapter of 18W or greater, sold separately).
- Apple AirPlay 2, Automatic Trueplay, voice enabled, button controls, line-in ready; USB-C can charge a phone.
- Replaceable battery; "first product made with renewable plastic sourced from bio-based materials"; FSC-certified paper packaging.
- Group up to four speakers on the go; can pair identical speakers for stereo or act as surrounds.

wikis.title: Sonos introduces Sonos Play and Era 100 SL
wikis.summary: Sonos press release of 10 March 2026 for the $299 Sonos Play portable speaker and $189 Era 100 SL, available March 31, 2026.
wikis.body:
- Santa Barbara, Calif., March 10, 2026.
- Sonos Play: versatile speaker; WiFi grouping or stereo pairing, Charging Base; removable utility loop; 24 hours battery; IP67 waterproof; built-in power bank to charge a phone; for the first time group multiple speakers from a Bluetooth connection when away (phone plus up to three additional Sonos Play or Move 2 speakers); Automatic Trueplay; replaceable battery; voice services, Spotify Connect, Apple AirPlay 2.
- Sonos Era 100 SL: simplified entry with a mic-free design and streamlined features; expands into stereo pairing or home theater.
- Quotes from CEO Tom Conrad and Chris Kallai, VP of Product Creation.
